title: Construction Manager, GES NA, Design and Construction
descriptionHtml:
As a Construction Manager within Global Engineering Services (GES) North America (NA) Design & Construction (D&C), you are Amazon's owner's representative throughout the full construction lifecycle. You play an integral role in delivering the built facilities and infrastructure that power Amazon's logistics network — including sortation centers, delivery stations, and auxiliary buildings — through new builds, retrofits, and expansions.

In this role, you serve as the primary point of interface between Amazon and its external partners — developers, general contractors, design engineers, and authorities having jurisdiction (AHJ) — while collaborating closely with internal stakeholders responsible for equipping, furnishing, and operating our facilities. You are accountable for the safe, on-time, in scope, and on-budget delivery of construction projects, and you bring a disciplined approach to budget management, schedule oversight, contract execution, and quality assurance.

You operate with a high degree of independence within your assigned region, managing multiple concurrent projects while maintaining clear and transparent communication with all project stakeholders. This role combines construction management, engineering, project planning, contract management, and facilities delivery — and requires approximately 60% regional travel within North America.

This role requires 60% regional travel on a yearly basis. When not traveling, you must have availability to work from a corporate office. Candidates should either live near or be willing to relocate within a reasonable commuting distance of one of the corporate office locations listed. Relocation assistance may be provided.


Key job responsibilities
Safety & Compliance
- Champion Amazon's safety programs and standards across all internal and external project teams; hold all accountable to a safety-first culture
- Interface and coordinate with Authorities Having Jurisdiction (AHJ) to maintain regulatory compliance and ensure seamless project execution
- Lead or assist in negotiations with regulatory bodies as required for permitting and approvals

Project & Construction Management
- Manage multiple concurrent projects simultaneously — ranging from small renovations to large-scale ($100M+) new facility builds — from design phase through construction completion and operational handover
- Serve as Amazon's owner's representative and primary integrator between construction execution teams and internal stakeholders (operations, equipment, IT, etc.)
- Review construction documents, drawings, and specifications for conformance to Amazon's building standards and design guidelines
- Identify and resolve design conflicts, schedule clashes, and coordination gaps with other Amazon execution teams
- Conduct detailed reviews of contractor bid packages, budgets, and schedules to identify and resolve discrepancies
- Assess project performance through Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) for safety, quality, cost, schedule, and sustainability

Budget, Schedule & Contract Management
- Own comprehensive budget tracking, cashflow forecasting, and cost management across assigned projects
- Review, analyze, and respond to all proposed cost and time change requests submitted by external project teams
- Negotiate construction, procurement, and labor contracts with developers and general contractors; present formal documentation for approval when required
- Ensure contracts are fit for purpose, cost-effective, and incorporate appropriate service level agreements
- Advise on the impact of changes in scope, schedule, cost, and permitting

Contractor & Stakeholder Management
- Audit contractor performance to ensure skills, competencies, and resources are appropriate for the work being performed
- Ensure contracted resources deliver work that meets duration and quality targets; address and resolve underperformance issues
- Coach and guide project teams — including developers, design engineers, general contractors, subcontractors, and internal stakeholders — throughout the full project lifecycle
- Inform developers and contractors of projected changes in resource or work demand to enable proactive planning
- Partner with teams responsible for base building management transition and oversight of all turnover documentation

Communication & Reporting
- Maintain clear, concise, and transparent communication with all internal and external stakeholders on project status, risks, and key developments
- Utilize Amazon's information systems to record and update schedule, budget, and other key project data
- Participate in weekly Architect, Owner, and Contractor (AOC) meetings; provide input on root causes and corrective actions
- Prepare reports, specifications, and technical analyses to define design requirements, equipment needs, and services for expansion and remodel projects

Innovation & Continuous Improvement
- Provide critical review of current design standards to identify value engineering and design enhancement opportunities
- Seek sustainable, environmentally responsible solutions throughout the construction process in alignment with Amazon's building practices
- Identify and implement process improvements that drive better outcomes across safety, cost, schedule, and quality

A day in the life
Each day, you act as Amazon's owner on the ground — ensuring the safe, on-time, and on-budget execution of construction projects across your region. Your day may include:
- Coordinating with general contractors on project status, upcoming milestones, and emerging risks
- Reviewing and responding to RFIs, submittals, change order requests, and schedule updates
- Participating in AOC meetings and driving accountability across the project team
- Conducting site visits to verify construction quality and safety compliance
- Updating Amazon's project management systems with current budget, schedule, and status information
- Collaborating with internal stakeholders on facility readiness, equipment coordination, and operational handover planning
- Reviewing design documents and providing feedback to engineering and design partner

About the team
At Amazon, the GES NA D&C team is a diverse group of engineers, construction managers, and preconstruction professionals who deliver the physical infrastructure behind Amazon's logistics network. We are employee owners who take pride in delivering high-quality, innovative facilities — on time and on budget — for our internal customers and the communities we serve. We are committed to being Earth's best employer and to building a more sustainable future through every project we deliver.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Architecture, Construction Management, Engineering, or a related field
- 5+ years of experience as an Architect, Engineer, Construction Manager, or in a related construction discipline

title: Sr Software Development Manager, EC2
descriptionHtml:
The Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2) Instance Networking team owns the packet pipeline that powers networking for every EC2 instance. Our software defined networking powers features like Virtual Private Cloud (“VPC”), features like firewalling (security groups), novel performance and scaling innovations and even billing and monitoring. Our vision is to combine the performance of bare metal networking while maintaining all the benefits of the cloud, to deliver features not possible on bare metal i.e. true Software Defined Networking (SDN).

We are looking for a world-class technical leader (Sr. Software Development Manager) to manage multiple teams and strategic initiatives for EC2 instance networking in Seattle, WA or San Diego, CA.

We are builders, focused on the next generation of our instance networking platform: the packet pipeline, the Elastic Network Adapter (ENA), and the embedded software that runs directly on Nitro cards. We work side by side with Annapurna Labs on the Nitro cards of the future.

This is a leadership role with real surface area. You will lead multiple teams, set technical strategy for EC2 instance networking, and partner with Principal Engineers, Senior Managers, and executives on requirements and direction that reach across all of Amazon. The problems are hard, the scope is company-wide, and the work is visible to the most senior leaders at AWS. We work on problems that matter, and we have a good time doing it. If that sounds like you, we want to talk.


Key job responsibilities
As a Senior Software Development Manager, you will:
• Own the technical and product vision for a foundational layer of AWS infrastructure.
• Partner with leaders and executives across the company to understand diverse requirements, set priorities, and drive direction across organizational boundaries.
• Hire, grow, and lead a team of Software Development Managers and engineers; mentor and coach them toward their next level.
• Build a team culture people want to be part of and take career growth seriously.
• Own the operational health of your team's security, availability, and performance.
• Run a development process that ships meaningful improvements to customers continuously.
• Set the engineering bar: design, implementation, testing, version control, documentation, deployment, monitoring, and operations.


A day in the life
You will work on problems that don't have textbook answers. How do you process packets at line rate on a resource-constrained Nitro card — handling encapsulation, security-group enforcement, and metering — without adding latency a customer could ever notice? How do you roll out memory-safety and packet-integrity improvements across millions of hosts worldwide without dropping a single customer's packet? You will take ideas from a whiteboard sketch through requirements, design, and launch, and you will see them run at a scale almost nowhere else can offer.

About the team
We are a team with a wide range of experience and tenure, and we invest in bringing new members up to speed. Knowledge sharing and mentorship are part of how we work, not an afterthought. We think about each engineer's growth when we assign projects, matching people to work that stretches them toward what they want to do next.

Basic qualifications

- 10+ years of engineering experience
- 5+ years of engineering team management experience
- 10+ years of planning, designing, developing and delivering consumer software experience
- Experience partnering with product or program management teams
- Experience managing multiple concurrent programs, projects and development teams in an Agile environment

Preferred qualifications

- Experience partnering with product and program management teams
- Experience designing and developing large scale, high-traffic applications

title: Critical Infrastructure Electrical Engineer, Field Engineering
descriptionHtml:
As an Amazon Critical Infrastructure Engineer, you will provide full life-cycle support to AWS Data Centers from design inception through site improvement and maintenance. You will be the ‘go to’ engineering resource for your region when technical advice is needed, and will use your subject matter expertise and engage with diverse teams to:
• Troubleshoot, conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and create Corrective Action (CA) documentation for site/equipment failures.
• Directly support operational issues with ad-hoc training, complex operating procedure reviews, including critical equipment, and event support.
• Own the conceptual design for existing data center upgrades and design-solutions, which add capacity, improve availability, increase efficiency and sustainability.
• Interface with internal data center operations team, data center design engineering team, server hardware team, environmental health and safety team to promote standards that maintain consistency and reliability in services delivered.
• Develop innovative solutions for AWS’s data centers.
• Work on concurrent projects, sometimes in multiple geographical regions.
• Initiate and lead engineering audits including on-site visits within Amazon’s data centers. Produce reports outlining risks with recommended mitigations and remediations.
• Act as resident engineer during new construction projects. Support construction, commissioning, and turnover.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.


Key job responsibilities
Amazon's vision is to be the world's most customer-centric company, and this role is key to that vision. As an Amazon Critical Infrastructure Engineer, you will be leading projects to fit out our data centers to meet ever-evolving customer needs as we continue expanding our fleet to hyper-scale. As an ideal candidate you:
• Possess Strong Engineering Judgement and are able to provide recommendations despite uncertainty/ambiguity.
• Are detail and data oriented.
• Have experience solving problems with engineered solutions.
• Have experience managing engineering projects and consultants.
• Build trust and relationships with different stakeholders (e.g., Operations, Controls, Construction, Design, Commissioning, Product Managers, Technical Program Managers, ).
• Are adaptable and inclined to get into the field to see things up close.
• Excited about a mix of office and field work.


A day in the life
Each day you will interact with different teams responsible for all aspects of the data centers. You will prioritize your activities to support data center capacity availability and safety focusing on the actions that are most impactful. You will have the opportunity to work on projects locally and globally.

If you meet these qualifications, exude passion, and enjoy the challenge of innovative projects at hyper-scale, this job is for you!


About the team
Why AWS

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Diverse Experiences

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Inclusive Team Culture

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship and Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

title: Senior Workforce Strategist & HR Business Partner
descriptionHtml:
At Audible, we believe stories have the power to transform lives. It’s why we work with some of the world’s leading creators to produce and share audio storytelling with our millions of global listeners. We are dreamers and inventors who come from a wide range of backgrounds and experiences to empower and inspire each other. Imagine your future with us.

ABOUT THIS ROLE
Audible's People & Places HRBP team is seeking a Senior Workforce Strategist & HRBP, a hybrid role centered on workforce planning expertise and strategic HR business partnership. You'll serve as a trusted advisor in driving end-to-end workforce planning: building models, running multi-scenario analyses, forecasting, and translating long-range business plans into actionable strategies. You will partner to translate business strategy into talent decisions, driving data informed planning that optimizes size, structure, location and capability.

This role is both strategic and hands-on. You’ll drive shaping workforce planning strategies alongside Sr HRBPs and business leaders that ensure the right talent, in the right roles, at the right time. You’ll partner through org design, coaching and change management as a secondary function. You bring experience in workforce analytics, headcount modeling, scenario planning, and cross-functional collaboration. If you thrive at the intersection of people strategy, data, business insight, and people decisions in a fast-paced, creative environment, and want to be part of Audible's AI-forward strategy and navigate the people side of AI transformation, we'd like to speak with you.

As a Senior Workforce Strategist & HR Business Partner, you will...
- Drive end-to-end strategic workforce planning—headcount modelling, talent supply/demand analysis, scenario planning—to support multi-year business objectives
- Develop and execute 1- and 3-year workforce plans aligned to operational planning cycles, partnering with HR, Finance, and business leadership to ensure the right roles, levels, and locations to deliver on goals
- Drive location strategy decisions—geographic expansion, consolidation, and distributed team design.
- Leverage workforce planning analytics and behavioral insights to deliver data-informed recommendations that accelerate innovation and enhance customer experience at acceptable cost
- Design and implement organization structures that optimize for speed, efficiency, and scalability across tech and non-tech functions, including spans & layers analysis, role ratio optimization, and cost modelling
- Develop AI talent strategies and frameworks, forecasting AI skill needs
- Conduct organizational assessments to identify structural gaps, span of control considerations, talent distribution patterns, redundancies, and opportunities to streamline decision-making and improve overall org health; present recommendations to Audible's C-Suite leaders
- Define and track metrics that influence stakeholders, measure success, and surface workforce trends, informing strategic direction.
- Serve as a trusted strategic advisor to senior leaders across tech and non-tech orgs, translating business strategy into people strategy that drives performance and sustainable growth
- Provide candid leadership coaching to help managers build high-performing, inclusive teams
- Lead org design and change management with empathy and rigor—finding creative paths forward when playbooks don't exist
- Anticipate challenges by staying close to the business, diagnosing root causes early, and delivering adaptive, lasting solutions
- Strengthen performance, engagement, and retention through lightweight, scalable processes aligned to how Audible operates
- Drive improvements to talent mechanisms—promotion, calibration, succession, and talent review—in partnership with HRBPs, COEs, and cross-functional leaders
- Partner on leading change management within AI transformation — helping teams embrace AI tools while maintaining a people-first approach
- Recognize when solutions require additional technical guidance and advocate for resources by influencing cross-functional teams.

ABOUT AUDIBLE
Audible is the leading producer and provider of audio storytelling. We spark listeners' imaginations, offering immersive, cinematic experiences full of inspiration and insight to enrich our customers daily lives. We are a global company with an entrepreneurial spirit. We are dreamers and inventors who are passionate about the positive impact Audible can make for our customers and our neighbors. This spirit courses throughout Audible, supporting a culture of creativity and inclusion built on our People Principles and our mission to build more equitable communities in the cities we call home.

- Experience with workforce planning
- 7+ years of progressive HR or workforce planning experience, including 3+ years independently driving strategic workforce planning (headcount modeling, scenario planning, talent supply/demand analysis)
- Experience supporting both technical and non-technical talent populations
- Analytical and data modeling skills, with demonstrated ability to build workforce models, interpret trends, and translate complex data into clear, actionable recommendations for senior stakeholders
- Bachelor's degree or above in Human Resources, Business, Organizational Development, Psychology, or a related field
- Certification in org design methodologies (e.g., Galbraith Star Model, McKinsey 7S) or workforce planning

Preferred qualifications

- Experience supporting organizations of 500+ employees across 5+ countries
- Demonstrated ability to operate independently with minimal direction in ambiguous environments
- HRBP Experience in high-growth media, entertainment, technology, or creative industry environments

title: Sr Program Mgr - Benchmarking & Strategy, AMXL Benchmarking
descriptionHtml:
We are seeking a strategic, analytically rigorous Senior Benchmarking and Strategy Program Manager to join the AMXL Global Benchmarking team. This role goes beyond study execution — you will own the end-to-end benchmarking lifecycle from intake through partnered implementation, lead complex multi-stakeholder studies, develop frameworks and methodologies, and translate competitive insights into actionable recommendations that influence operational strategy across a global logistics network. You will serve as a thought leader within the program, shaping the portfolio roadmap, mentoring peers, and driving cross-functional alignment to ensure benchmarking insights result in measurable business outcomes. This is an ideal role for someone who combines deep analytical capability with strategic thinking, stakeholder influence, and a passion for competitive intelligence.

Key job responsibilities
- Portfolio & Study Leadership: Own and lead end-to-end competitive benchmarking studies — from scoping and methodology design through execution, analysis, and recommendation development, across multiple concurrent workstreams spanning delivery experience, customer journey, returns, packaging, service quality and more.

descriptionHtml:
The Amazon Private Brands team is looking for an entrepreneurial, analytical and highly motivated Planning & Forecasting Manager (PFM) to join our team to launch new high quality selection under Amazon Private Brands. PFM manages customer inputs and works to remove inefficiencies in the supply chain. PFMs play a critical role in delivering the ideal customer experience, ensuring we have the right product quantities, in the right places, at the right time (i.e., “in stock” and available to ship immediately). To achieve this mission as cost effectively as possible, PFMs work to continuously optimize our end-to-end supply chain, engaging with internal stakeholders and sellers to improve operational performance metrics, and driving system and process automation with key stakeholder teams. PFMs own the operational components of the P&L, and are responsible for setting and executing operational strategies to optimize sales, margins, turns, and inventory health.


A day in the life
PFMs will have high level responsibility covering the below mentioned capabilities and skills.
a) Supply chain, Marketplace and customer experience: PFMs possess deep Marketplace and supply chain knowledge. They manage inputs that impact the seller and customer experience and are responsible for cost reduction and removing waste in the supply chain. The PFM (i) Understands complete end-to-end supply chain and complex modeling of workflows on marketplace/seller central for PL (ii) Identifies and articulates strategic importance of metrics as a basis for managing tradeoffs, improving the seller/customer experience and making decisions with internal and external stakeholders. (iii) Adopts and tailors account management/supply chain best practices to meet PB requirements. (iv) Makes decisions based on analysis and proposes specific cost reduction and waste removal opportunities within and across categories and external support teams. (v) Identifies, manages and executes multiple medium to large sized supply chain projects. The projects are typically cross-functional and involve external partners.
b) Automation & system enhancements: PFMs are responsible for identifying automation opportunities, improving non-automated processes, and building to scale. They influence and partner with technical teams to drive adoption of standards. Driving continuous improvement is a core functional skill for the PFM role. The PFM will (i) Proactively work to lead process improvement. (ii) Understands how to navigate across Amazon teams and systems to meet team business objectives. (iii) Builds networks with other peers and Leaders and aligns goals across Amazon functional teams. Does not rely on existing way of doing things; challenges best practices to invent novel ways of solving a problem.(iv) Assesses problems in real time and acts quickly to uncover any potential areas of risk or opportunity
c) Seller management: PFMs are responsible for engaging with sellers to focus on improving operational supply chain performance.
d) Strategic planning: PFMs are responsible for defining the operational strategy, contributing to the sales and operations planning process, and influencing internal and external strategic partners. The PFM (i) Dives deep to analyze supply chain and operation metrics and develop instock strategy for the category. (ii) Creates annual instock strategic and operational plans for the business. (iii) Contributes to OP1 and OP2 planning documentation and process (iv) Works closely with seller facing leadership and/or operations senior leaders on strategies to reduce cost, lead time, and waste across the end-to-end supply chain.

title: Power DVT Engineer, Power DVT Team
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is Amazon's low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve people and organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.

As a Power DVT (Design Verification Test) Engineer on the Amazon LEO avionics team, you will own the complete design verification lifecycle for power electronics systems destined for Low Earth Orbit. You will bridge design intent and flight-ready hardware by developing comprehensive test strategies, executing rigorous validation campaigns, and driving cross-functional collaboration across power design, SI/PI, FPGA, firmware, and system integration teams. Your technical leadership will ensure our satellite power systems meet stringent space-grade requirements while mentoring junior engineers and establishing scalable test methodologies that accelerate our mission to deliver global broadband connectivity.

Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Key job responsibilities
Design Verification Planning
- Develop comprehensive Design Verification Plans (DVPs) in collaboration with power design engineers, SI/PI engineers, and system integration teams.
- Apply Design for Testability (DFT) principles during design reviews, ensuring test point accessibility, boundary scan implementation, and built-in self-test capabilities.
- Focus on design verification from subsystem testing through functional testing and system performance validation.

Test Development & Execution
- Develop test methodologies and fixtures as needed.
- Develop and maintain test scripts in collaboration with design and firmware engineers.
- Use software simulation tools to model circuits and systems, analyze performance, identify failure modes, and optimize designs.
- Ensure proper test execution, data collection, review, and system requirement verification.
- Own and manage comprehensive test procedures and execute system and board-level test plans.

Technical Problem-Solving
- Troubleshoot and propose viable fixes when faced with electrical failures.
- Develop practical, cost-effective solutions that address root causes and prevent future occurrences.
- Maintain requirements traceability during testing and solve integration and test problems in real time.

Leadership & Collaboration
- Provide technical support to less experienced engineers during DVT execution, actively unblocking technical challenges and accelerating their development through hands-on guidance.
- Lead small groups of DVT engineers across multiple designs.
- Participate in reviews with cross-functional teams and management about test readiness and DVT results.
- Conduct test readiness reviews and align with stakeholders on data review activities.

Ser o guardião da segurança no turno, garantindo que todas as normas, procedimentos e práticas de segurança sejam seguidas sem exceção.
Promover uma cultura de segurança em que cada associado se sinta responsável pela sua segurança e pela segurança dos colegas.

Garantir o cumprimento dos padrões de qualidade nos processos de grading e disposição, minimizando erros e retrabalho.

Formar e desenvolver equipes de alta performance, identificando talentos, promovendo o crescimento individual e garantindo a retenção dos melhores profissionais.
Conduzir treinamentos operacionais e reciclagens periódicas, assegurando que 100% do time esteja capacitado para executar os processos com excelência.

Influenciar e inspirar pessoas em todos os níveis para atingir e superar as metas operacionais do site.

- Gestão Operacional e de Processos
Gerenciar a operação do turno noturno de ponta a ponta, garantindo o cumprimento das metas de produtividade, qualidade e throughput nos processos de recebimento, triagem, grading e disposição de itens retornados.
Criar, documentar e implementar procedimentos operacionais padrão (SOPs), garantindo padronização e repetibilidade na execução.

title: Automation Engineer
descriptionHtml:

Our buildings deliver tens of thousands of products to hundreds of countries worldwide, every day. Your expertise will be essential in troubleshooting complex control systems, analyzing performance metrics, and driving continuous improvement initiatives. You'll collaborate with cross-functional teams to optimize material handling equipment (MHE) systems and implement innovative projects. You'll work with state-of-the-art technology, including conveyors, sortation systems, scanners, cameras, print and apply systems, and SCADA devices and programs. title: Automation Planning Manager, NA Automation Deployment Planning
descriptionHtml:
NA Last Mile Automation Planning team is seeking a qualified Automation Planning Manager to join the NA Automation Deployment Planning team within Worldwide Engineering & Innovation (WWEI). This team is responsible for the planning, deployment coordination, and implementation tracking of automation programs across AMZL, RSR, and SSD delivery station networks including ADTA (Auto Divert to Aisle) new launch and retrofits, Mechlite conveyance installations, and new innovation deployment planning.

In this role, the individual will have direct responsibility for managing site-level deployment timelines and project execution for assigned automation programs and regions. The Automation Planning Manager will serve as the central coordinator between a multitude of stakeholders including Entitlements,) Pre-Construction, Construction, Start-Up Execution, Design Engineering, WHS, Capacity Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, and automation vendors. This role calls for an individual who over-indexes on ownership to de-conflict multiple competing projects at each site and drive timely delivery of automation milestones.
This role’s scope necessitates the ability to solve ambiguous issues, provide effective solutions to gaps between teams, processes and systems, and maintain clear line-of-sight into site-level schedules that feed network-wide automation deployment goals.


Key job responsibilities
• Manage site-level project timelines for automation deployments for automation innovation programs across assigned vendors and programs, ensuring alignment between design, construction, equipment delivery, and site readiness milestones.
• Serve as the single-threaded planning owner for assigned sites, coordinating across Entitlements, Pre-Construction, Construction, Start-Up Execution, Design Engineering, WHS, Capacity Engineering, Supply Chain and Operations.
• Track and escalate vendor/integrator dependencies, material delivery timelines, and FAT (Factory Acceptance Testing) schedules to ensure on-time deployment.
• Solve complex problems that pose risk to project delivery and key milestones through inquisitive deep dives with stakeholder Subject Matter Expert (SME) input.
• Compile, manage, and report on weekly project metrics including deployment pulse checks, site readiness status, and permitting progress.
• Support the Daily/Weekly Program Calls by providing site-level status updates and escalation items.
• Clearly communicate project issues and risks to senior leaders in writing and via in-person/remote meetings.
• Assist in the development of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) to improve deployment planning efficiency and cross-team handoffs.
• Identify opportunities to reduce spend in assigned regions through analysis of available assets, business needs, and returns on investment.
• Work within various time constraints to meet critical business needs, including OP planning cycles and network optimization deadlines.
• Up to 10% travel required.


A day in the life
Your day starts with a quick scan of overnight vendor updates and site status changes, then moves into the Daily Automation Call where you provide deployment updates for your assigned sites. Throughout the day, you coordinate across Construction, Design Engineering, Supply Chain, Startup Execution, Capacity Planning, and assigned vendor teams to resolve permitting questions, track equipment shipments, and unblock site readiness milestones. You compile weekly pulse check data, update project trackers, and prepare escalation summaries for leadership. No two days look the same — one day you may be troubleshooting a material delay from the vendor, and the next you are aligning a FAT schedule with a new technology pending deployment start. You work primarily from your desk with occasional site visits to observe installations and validate deployment readiness.

- 3+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience

- Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
- Experience working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams

descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people. If you'd like to help us build the place to find and buy anything online, this is your chance to make history.

The Global Network Delivery organization is looking to hire a highly motivated, best-in-class Network Deployment Planner to join our growing Planning and Implementation team within AWS Data Center Delivery. The team responsibilities involve scoping and planning interdependent capacity scaling projects and new network capacity deployments across several data center locations. They will review project forecasts and assure physical infrastructure resources are available for their execution.

The Network Deployment Planner will work closely with infrastructure supply chain & procurement, network engineering and technical program managers to plan and deliver customer capacity to the local data center installation & deployment technicians to facilitate smooth capacity execution.

The ideal candidate will possess a technology background that enables them to understand the complexities of the sophisticated network architecture of Amazon data centers. To be a qualified candidate you must be highly autonomous, very detail oriented, possesses strong written and verbal communication skills and have experience in managing network deployment projects. They will be competent in networking principles, data center operations, cable infrastructure and fiber solutions.

This position will provide the individual with high levels of autonomous work with minimal supervision to drive the stability and sustainability of our next-generation networks and to assist in the development of innovative ways to automate and scale our network as we expand. The desire and ability to work in a fast paced, ambiguous, collaborative environment is essential for success.

* Ensure adherence to timelines.
* Deliver sustainable and repeatable solutions and processes always with an eye on improvement.
* Work closely with our Install/Deployment Technicians, Supply Chain & Procurement, Network Engineers and Technical Project Manager teams to ensure fast, smooth delivery of on-demand customer capacity.

* Experience with cabling infrastructure best practices and methodologies.
* Familiarity with common networking terms.
* Excellent judgement and analytical skills, ability to prioritize tasks based on fluctuating needs. - Strong prioritization and time management ability.
* Coordination of design, project timeline/schedule and construction milestones.
* Experience in core project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management. Must be well organized and able to work effectively under time pressure.

*Why AWS*
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

*Diverse Experiences*
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

*Work/Life Balance*
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

*Inclusive Team Culture*
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

title: Applied Scientist III, Sponsored Products and Brands - Advertiser Growth - Cross-border Seller Experience (CBSX)
descriptionHtml:
The Sponsored Products and Brands team at Amazon Ads is re-imagining the advertising landscape through generative AI technologies, revolutionizing how millions of customers discover products and engage with brands across Amazon.com and beyond. We are at the forefront of re-inventing advertising experiences, bridging human creativity with artificial intelligence to transform every aspect of the advertising lifecycle from ad creation and optimization to performance analysis and customer insights. We are a passionate group of innovators dedicated to developing responsible and intelligent AI technologies that balance the needs of advertisers, enhance the shopping experience, and strengthen the marketplace. If you're energized by solving complex challenges and pushing the boundaries of what's possible with AI, join us in shaping the future of advertising.

We are looking for a Senior Applied Scientist to build the science that helps Amazon's advertisers grow — with a focus on Cross Border Sellers who face distinct barriers as they scale across multiple marketplaces, and this role is about understanding those pain points deeply and removing them: building intelligent, autonomous solutions that simplify advertising, act efficiently on the advertiser's behalf, and let advertisers accelerate their growth and success.

We expect a Senior Scientist to think innovatively about how to reduce the effort and complexity of advertising for these advertisers. Working backwards from their needs — spanning hands-off sellers and global brands with cross-marketplace operations — you will take the lead on medium-to-large, ambiguous problems where neither the problem nor the solution is well defined, invent new methods, validate them through rigorous experimentation, and deliver customer-facing products with measurable business impact. This role combines science depth, product focus, and hands-on engineering: you will raise the science bar, build consensus on approach across product and engineering partners, and mentor scientists and engineers while remaining deeply hands-on with the hardest technical problems.

Key job responsibilities
As a Senior Applied Scientist on this team you will:

- Understand the pain points of Cross border advertisers as they scale across marketplaces, and build science-driven solutions that remove barriers and accelerate their growth and success.
- Build agentic and ML systems that autonomously create, structure, and manage ad campaigns on advertisers' behalf, encoding auction and marketplace dynamics (bidding, budget pacing, targeting decisions) while balancing advertiser ROI, shopper experience, and marketplace health.
- Innovate on new, simpler ways to advertise powered by GenAI, and push the frontier of existing autonomous programs (e.g., auto-targeting, global lift-and-shift) while proposing and prototyping the next generation of campaign automation.
- Develop models across the campaign lifecycle — opportunity discovery, ranking, ad-readiness and demand prediction, and bid/budget optimization — and apply the right approach for each problem, from classical ML to LLM/reasoning methods.
- Define and curate the datasets and signals needed to train and evaluate these systems — advertiser and campaign data, cross-marketplace performance, auction and bid/budget signals, impressions, clicks, conversions, and search-term/keyword performance.
- Own core parts of the agentic architecture — planning, tool use and integration (e.g., MCP), reasoning frameworks (e.g., ReAct, CoT/ToT), and model customization — and define evaluation and safety methodology so that automated decisions are reliable and trustworthy.
- Stay deeply hands-on: write production-quality, critical-path code and build core components that take systems from prototype to launch on large-scale pipelines (Spark/EMR, Airflow) and online serving.
- Raise the science bar: mentor scientists and engineers, review designs and experiment plans, and communicate results and tradeoffs clearly to technical and business leaders.


About the team

Autonomous SP drives growth and simplifies advertising for Amazon's hands-off advertisers by creating and enhancing autonomous campaign solutions. We lead existing successful programs, including auto-targeting and global lift-and-shift, and continually innovate by building new, simpler campaign constructs powered by GenAI to act efficiently on advertisers' behalf.

Cross-border Seller Experience (CBSX) focuses on developing targeted solutions for domestic and global advertisers with multi-marketplace operations. By understanding and addressing their unique Seller Central needs, we optimize for cross-marketplace efficiency, improved performance, and streamlined advertising experiences. Our team operates horizontally, delivering impactful solutions that benefit both hands-on and hands-off advertisers globally.

Together, we sit within Sponsored Products and Brands, which is re-imagining advertising through the latest generative AI — building responsible, intelligent systems that balance the needs of advertisers, the shopping experience, and marketplace health.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of building machine learning models for business application experience
- PhD, or Master's degree and 6+ years of applied research experience
- Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language
- Experience with neural deep learning methods and machine learning

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with modeling tools such as R, scikit-learn, Spark MLLib, MxNet, Tensorflow, numpy, scipy etc.
- Experience with large scale distributed systems such as Hadoop, Spark etc.

title: Member of Technical Staff, Frontier AI & Robotics (FAR)
descriptionHtml:
Join the next revolution in robotics at Amazon's Frontier AI & Robotics team, where you'll work alongside world-renowned AI pioneers to push the boundaries of what's possible in robotic intelligence. As a Member of Technical Staff, you'll be at the forefront of developing breakthrough foundation models that enable robots to perceive, understand, and interact with the world in unprecedented ways. You'll drive independent research initiatives in areas such as perception, manipulation, science understanding, locomotion, manipulation, sim2real transfer, multi-modal foundation models and multi-task robot learning, designing novel frameworks that bridge the gap between state-of-the-art research and real-world deployment at Amazon scale.

In this role, you'll balance innovative technical exploration with practical implementation, collaborating with platform teams to ensure your models and algorithms perform robustly in dynamic real-world environments. You'll have access to Amazon's vast computational resources, enabling you to tackle ambitious problems in areas like very large multi-modal robotic foundation models and efficient, promptable model architectures that can scale across diverse robotic applications.


Key job responsibilities
- Drive independent research initiatives across the robotics stack, including robotics foundation models, focusing on breakthrough approaches in perception, and manipulation, for example open-vocabulary panoptic scene understanding, scaling up multi-modal LLMs, sim2real/real2sim techniques, end-to-end vision-language-action models, efficient model inference, video tokenization
- Design and implement novel deep learning architectures that push the boundaries of what robots can understand and accomplish
- Lead full-stack robotics projects from conceptualization through deployment, taking a system-level approach that integrates hardware considerations with algorithmic development, ensuring robust performance in production environments
- Collaborate with platform and hardware teams to ensure seamless integration across the entire robotics stack, optimizing and scaling models for real-world applications
- Contribute to the team's technical strategy and help shape our approach to next-generation robotics challenges

A day in the life
- Design and implement novel foundation model architectures and innovative systems and algorithms, leveraging our extensive infrastructure to prototype and evaluate at scale
- Collaborate with our world-class research team to solve complex technical challenges
- Lead technical initiatives from conception to deployment, working closely with robotics engineers to integrate your solutions into production systems
- Participate in technical discussions and brainstorming sessions with team leaders and fellow scientists
- Leverage our massive compute cluster and extensive robotics infrastructure to rapidly prototype and validate new ideas
- Transform theoretical insights into practical solutions that can handle the complexities of real-world robotics applications

About the team
At Frontier AI & Robotics, we're not just advancing robotics – we're reimagining it from the ground up. Our team is building the future of intelligent robotics through innovative foundation models and end-to-end learned systems. We tackle some of the most challenging problems in AI and robotics, from developing sophisticated perception systems to creating adaptive manipulation strategies that work in complex, real-world scenarios.

What sets us apart is our unique combination of ambitious research vision and practical impact. We leverage Amazon's massive computational infrastructure and rich real-world datasets to train and deploy state-of-the-art foundation models. Our work spans the full spectrum of robotics intelligence – from multimodal perception using images, videos, and sensor data, to sophisticated manipulation strategies that can handle diverse real-world scenarios. We're building systems that don't just work in the lab, but scale to meet the demands of Amazon's global operations.

Join us if you're excited about pushing the boundaries of what's possible in robotics, working with world-class researchers, and seeing your innovations deployed at unprecedented scale.

Basic qualifications

- PhD, or Master's degree and 4+ years of CS, CE, ML or related field experience
- Experience in Java, C++, Python, or a related language
- Experience applying theoretical models in an applied environment
- Experience building machine learning models or developing algorithms for business application
- Experience in patents or publications at top-tier peer-reviewed conferences or journals
- Experience developing and implementing deep learning models
- Track record of solving complex technical problems

Preferred qualifications

- Experience using Unix/Linux
- Experience in professional software development
- First-author publications at major or top-tier ML/Robotics/AI conferences
- Experience with foundation models or large language models
- Background in Robotics, computer vision, or related fields
- Experience with sim2real transfer or multi-task learning
- Familiarity with distributed training systems
- Track record of deploying ML models in production environments
- Experience with large-scale robotic systems
- Extensive programming skills in Python and PyTorch/JAX

descriptionHtml:

We are looking for motivated, customer-focused individuals who want to join our team as an Area Manager. You will also play a key role in maintaining our customer expectations to ensure customer orders are delivered at the right time, to the right location.

Amazon's technology supply chain supports a complex and rapidly evolving portfolio of infrastructure, end-user equipment, and technology products across thousands of locations globally. As the business scales, we are building mechanisms that do more than consolidate information and react to problems after they emerge. We are looking to build the ability to identify risk early, evaluate scenarios, make clear trade-offs, and translate decisions into coordinated action across the organization.

We are seeking a senior leader to build and lead the enterprise S&OP capability within Supply Chain Planning.

This leader will manage a team responsible for establishing a common S&OP and risk-management mechanism across the business. The team will connect the plan with the multiple execution layers of the organization, ensuring material risks are identified early, scenarios are evaluated, trade-offs are understood, decisions are made at the appropriate level, and actions are driven to closure.

This role will also help define the digital evolution of S&OP. The successful candidate will partner with Product, Data, Analytics, and Technology teams to move S&OP from a largely human-orchestrated process toward an increasingly automated, exception-based, and intelligence-driven decision system. This includes integrating signals across systems, automating risk identification, enabling scenario modeling, and applying advanced analytics and AI to improve the speed, quality, and scalability of supply chain decisions.

The ideal candidate combines strong supply chain planning fundamentals, business judgment, analytical capability, technology orientation, and cross-functional leadership. They must be comfortable operating in ambiguity, challenging assumptions, simplifying complex problems, and influencing senior leaders across Supply Chain, Technology, Finance, Procurement, Operations, and customer organizations.

This is not a traditional reporting or meeting-management role. The successful candidate will build S&OP into a forward-looking enterprise decision mechanism that improves decision quality, business predictability, prioritization, and customer outcomes.

Key job responsibilities
- Lead and develop a team responsible for Enterprise S&OP/IBP, risk management, scenario planning, and cross-functional orchestration
- Establish and continuously improve the S&OP operating model connecting Plan with the multiple execution layers of the organization.
- Create a single, forward-looking view of material demand, supply, inventory, capacity, supplier, and customer risks, translating signals into prioritized decision points.
- Lead scenario analysis and evaluate trade-offs across customer service, inventory, cost, capacity, and business priorities.
- Establish escalation and decision mechanisms that enable leaders to focus on material risks and exceptions rather than status reporting.
- Ensure S&OP decisions translate into clear ownership, actions, timelines, and measurable closure across cross-functional teams.
- Define performance mechanisms that measure risk aging, decision effectiveness, mitigation progress, and customer delivery predictability.
- Partner with Product, Data, Analytics, and Technology teams to define the digital roadmap for S&OP, including signal integration, risk intelligence, scenario modeling, automation, and decision-support capabilities.
- Identify where fragmented systems, data defects, or manual processes require humans to act as integration layers and drive scalable solutions to eliminate these dependencies.
- Advance the use of analytics and AI to automate risk identification, prioritize exceptions, identify root causes, and support scenario-based decision making.
- Build closed-loop mechanisms where execution constraints, decisions, and actual outcomes continuously improve future planning and risk management.
- Simplify redundant processes and governance mechanisms while developing scalable capabilities that support new businesses, products, geographies, and fulfillment models.

A day in the life
In this role, you may begin the day reviewing emerging demand, supply, inventory, and execution signals with your team and determining which risks require intervention. You may work with Demand and Supply Planning leaders to evaluate a constrained product, challenge assumptions behind a customer requirement, or quantify the service and inventory implications of alternative decisions.

Later, you may lead an S&OP review where the objective is not to review every metric, but to align leaders around a small number of material risks, scenarios, and decisions. Your team will then ensure those decisions are translated into actions across the appropriate execution layers and tracked through closure.

You may also spend time with Product or Technology teams defining how a manual planning activity can be automated, determining which signals should feed a risk model, or designing how scenario-planning capabilities should support future business decisions.

The role requires balancing today's operating needs with the longer-term goal of building a more scalable system where humans spend less time assembling information and more time making high-quality decisions.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams experience
- 5+ years of team management experience
- 5+ years of cross functional project delivery experience
- 5+ years of supply chain experience
- 5+ years of program or project management experience
- Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements
- Bachelor's degree

Preferred qualifications

- Experience managing, analyzing and communicating results to senior leadership
- Master's degree
- Knowledge of supply chain management concepts - forecasting, planning, sourcing, optimization and logistics or equivalent
- Experience with ERP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle, Workday), or experience with advanced use of SQL for data mining and business intelligence

title: Sr. Global Expansion Manager, AWS Entity Strategy & Planning
descriptionHtml:
The AWS Global Expansion team is seeking a Sr. Global Expansion Manager. In this role you will plan and execute market entry strategy, problem solve for complex initiatives related to geographic expansion, and support with optimizing operational efficiency in existing countries. To do so, you will develop corporate entity strategy, driving technical and non-technical cross-functional stakeholders to ensure AWS can continue to operate efficiently and compliantly in new and existing countries. In addition to supporting AWS Infrastructure Services, you will also work across other AWS business lines, including sales, services, and supply chain in response to business needs and regulatory changes.

Our Global Expansion Managers have project management experience, strong judgment, technical aptitude for creating scalable processes, a disposition toward continuous learning, an interest in developing market entry strategies, a passion for navigating ambiguity, and the ability to deep dive across a wide range of topics and stakeholders.

Your role responsibilities include:

- Lead and advise a set of cross-functional teams, including Tax, Legal, Accounting, Treasury, Finance, Operations, Product, Engineering, HR, Public Policy, among others, to drive the global expansion of AWS.
- Execute multiple time-sensitive, large-scale projects to meet business objectives in defined project timeframes.
- Identify, drive, and develop best practices, technical solutions, process efficiencies, and project workflows.
Own project management and problem solving for compliance and risk related issues.
- Use quick judgement, have ability to influence without authority, apply commercial and technical aptitude to support with product scaling.
- Communicate effectively to technical and non-technical leadership, and bridge the end to end story of expanding into a given country.
- Collaborate with a diverse set of stakeholders and leaders across multiple time zones, where there may be competing priorities.
- Demonstrate and ‘connect-the-dots’ on how critical work streams are interrelated, for purposes of leadership escalations, reporting, and critical trade off decisions.

AWS Infrastructure Services (AIS)
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Key job responsibilities
1. Develop data-driven business cases to assess the viability of new product, service, and country expansions.
2. Design appropriate corporate structure strategy, policy, and controls to enable AWS to scale efficiently and compliantly.
3. Lead and advise a set of cross-functional teams to drive the global expansion of AWS, support with compliance, or facilitate divestiture. Build an execution strategy, and then drive cross-functional stakeholders to deliver.
4. Execute multiple time-sensitive, large-scale projects to meet business objectives in defined project timeframes.
5. Identify, drive, and develop best practices, technical solutions, process efficiencies, and project workflows.
6. Engage third parties (advisors, regulators, customers) to influence the adoption of AWS.
7. Write frequently and effectively. Operate autonomously. Enjoy navigating ambiguity.

About the team
Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

title: Mechatronic Apprentice I
descriptionHtml:
Operations is at the heart of Amazon’s business. We are known for our speed, accuracy, and exceptional service. Our buildings deliver tens of thousands of products to hundreds of countries worldwide, every day. Reliability Maintenance & Engineering (RME) are the business partners that work tirelessly behind the scenes to make it all happen. We drive continuous improvement, and maintain all of the Robotics and Material Handling Equipment (MHE) to ensure our customers are met with the Amazon smile. Come join us on our journey!
About the Role:

As a Mechatronics & Robotics Apprentice (MRA), you will learn to combine electronic, mechanical, computer and automation engineering skills at the workplace. During on-the-job learning (OJL) you will work with complex high-performance manufacturing systems and will learn to analyze, troubleshoot, and repair systems to maintain process efficiency. The focus of your role will be to learn the skills and abilities to ensure safety regulations and policies are adhered to, assist in the installation, maintenance, and repair of the automated packaging and distribution equipment, ensure preventative maintenance is conducted on time to a high standard, and provide high levels of equipment availability through continuous improvement.

You will be paired with journey workers to carry out their work at various facilities, including high automation and robotics facilities in connection with service operations. You will be expected to complete work based on technical documents and instructions and carry out your work in compliance with the relevant provisions and safety regulations.

You should be an effective communicator, work well in a team, and be self-motivated. You must have the ability to work collaboratively and coordinate your activities with upstream and downstream operations partners. In addition to developing your skills, you will be mentored by senior technicians to grow in your role.


Key job responsibilities
Key job responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
• You will perform preventative/predictive maintenance of conveyance equipment using the appropriate job plans, procedures, and manuals.

• You will conduct maintenance and basic troubleshooting of robotics and robotic work cells.

• You will troubleshoot electrical and mechanical problems related to all material handling equipment components.

• You will maintain and troubleshoot motors, photo eyes, relays, proximity sensors, solenoids, motor starters, tachs, etc.
• You must be able to move up to 49lbs, stand and walk during shifts lasting up to 12 hours, climb ladders and gangways safely, and without limitation, as well as perform regular bending, lifting, stretching, and reaching both below the waist and above the head

Program Requirements:
• Flexible to relocate after completion of the program

• Able to enroll in and attend a 9-week training at one of four designated training providers (Location to be determined post-interview)

• Meet the minimum qualifying score on a Mechanical Aptitude Test

Please note that while we strive to accommodate employees' preferences for shift assignments, due to operational requirements and scheduling constraints, we cannot guarantee a specific shift assignment.

Basic qualifications

- High School Diploma
- 1+ years of PC software experience including Microsoft Word, Excel and Outlook experience
- vocational/technical training or an associate degree or above, or 1+ years of Amazon RME (Reliability Maintenance Engineering) experience
- Experience troubleshooting and repairing operational items
- Knowledge of mathematics
- Experience measurement reading and interpretation
- Work flexible schedules including weekends, nights, and holidays

Preferred qualifications

- 4+ years of military experience
- Experience conducting predictive and preventative maintenance procedures
- Experience troubleshooting and diagnosing material handling equipment (MHE)
- Experience implementing safety standards
- Experience reading blueprints and electrical schematics

This role acts as Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment preventative maintenance (PM) and troubleshooting, reporting to a site’s Data Center Facility Manager (FM). Mechanical equipment includes CRAHU units, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers, water systems, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, and motors. Additional support equipment is included in the scope of the role which includes fire/life safety equipment, building automation systems, and general facilities equipment.

- 1+ years of Microsoft Office products and applications experience

title: Senior Specialist Solutions Architect, Amazon Quick, Data & AI GTM
descriptionHtml:
Are you passionate about helping customers unlock the power of generative artificial intelligence (AI) and business intelligence? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is seeking a Solutions Architect to become a thought leader and deep specialist in Amazon Quick, our AI assistant for work. In this role, you'll work at the intersection of data analytics and generative AI, helping organizations across industries become more proficient with data-driven decision making, AI-powered insights, and automated actions.

AWS Specialist Solutions Architects (SSAs) are technologists with deep domain-specific expertise, able to address advanced concepts and feature designs. As part of the AWS sales organization, SSAs work with customers who have complex challenges that require expert-level knowledge to solve. SSAs craft scalable, flexible, and resilient technical architectures that address those challenges. This might involve guiding customers as they refactor an application or designing entirely new cloud-based systems. Do you enjoy solving novel and unique technical challenges for customers? Become an AWS Specialist SA!

About the Org: The Worldwide Specialist Organization (WWSO) is part of AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS), which is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector. We work backwards from our customer’s most complex and business critical problems to build and execute go-to-market plans that turn AWS ideas into multi-billion-dollar businesses. WWSO teams include business development, specialist and technical solutions architecture. As part of WWSO, you'll provide expertise across the entire life cycle of an AWS customer initiative, from developing ideas for new services to accelerating the adoption of established businesses. We pride ourselves on thinking big, delivering exceptional results for our customers, and working across AWS as #OneTeam.

Key job responsibilities
- Serve as a Service Aligned Solutions Architect, functioning as a direct extension of the Amazon Quick service team — embedded with Product, Engineering, and Science to maintain deep technical currency and bring the voice of the customer into every sprint and roadmap decision.
- Lead technical solution discussions with customer teams, translating complex business needs into scalable architectures that deliver measurable business outcomes — informed by direct access to service team roadmaps, internal design documents, and engineering priorities.
- Design and architect end-to-end customer solutions leveraging Amazon Quick's capabilities including agentic features, dashboarding, and automation, ensuring solutions are extensible, secure, reliable, and cost-optimized. Leverage your tight coupling with the service team to push the boundaries of what's possible with the platform.
- Work closely with Product, Engineering, and Science teams as a trusted technical peer — participating in design reviews, beta programs, and feature validation cycles to ensure customer architectures align with platform direction and inform future development.
- Drive customer feedback to Product and Engineering teams, distilling insights into clear business and technical requirements that influence the Amazon Quick roadmap. As an extension of the service team, serve as the primary bridge between field realities and engineering priorities.
- Work with AWS field sales, training, and support teams to ensure customer success, while maintaining your unique position as a service-aligned resource with deeper product context than a generalist SA.
- Collaborate with Go-To-Market Specialist teams to develop and execute adoption strategies through direct customer engagements and scaled events, bringing service-team-level depth to every interaction.
- Share what you know by capturing best-practice knowledge from Engineering, Science, and field teams, including reference architectures and patterns amongst the worldwide AWS solution architect community in order to build a strong worldwide data and AI/ML community.
- Act as a thought leader by creating and delivering technical content such as white papers, blog posts, reference architectures, and workshops that educate customers on best practices for business intelligence and generative AI — content informed by your direct partnership with the service team's Science and Engineering orgs.
- Evangelize AWS services and solutions that benefit customers and publicly speak at events such as AWS Summits and AWS re:Invent, representing both the field SA perspective and the service team's technical vision.

A day in the life
Your daily schedule will be a dynamic mix of solving customers' challenges and creating scalable assets to further promote the knowledge and understanding of Amazon Quick. You will collaborate with field teams to drive successful customer outcomes, as well as work with service teams to incorporate customer feedback into the roadmap. You will partner closely with Go-To-Market (GTM) Specialist counterparts to develop strategies that drive customer adoption further in your territory through one-to-one customer engagement and one-to-many virtual and in-person events.

About the team
Within the Worldwide Specialist Organization (WWSO), this position is part of the Generative AI and Machine Learning Specialist Solutions Architecture organization, where you will join a global team focused on Amazon Quick. The team covers all aspects of Quick, including its agentic capabilities, dashboarding, and automation, with a mission to help organizations become more proficient with data and AI. You'll work in a collaborative environment where continuous learning and knowledge-sharing are core to how the team operates, staying at the forefront of a rapidly evolving space where generative AI is transforming how knowledge workers interact with data.

- Experience communicating across technical and non-technical audiences, including executive level stakeholders or clients
- 8+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, data science, data & analytics) experience

Preferred qualifications

- - Agentic Search Workflows: Architecting autonomous search engines that use multi-step reasoning (e.g., ReAct, Plan-and-Solve) to break complex user intents into sequential, multi-turn exploration paths.
