title: Digital Experience Manager, WW Sustainability
descriptionHtml:
Join us at the forefront of Amazon's sustainability initiatives to work on environmental and social advancements to support Amazon's long term worldwide sustainability strategy. At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people.

The Worldwide Sustainability (WWS) organization capitalizes on Amazon’s scale and speed to build a more resilient and sustainable company. We manage our social and environmental impacts globally, and drive solutions that enable our customers, businesses, and the world to become more sustainable.

The Sustainability Creative Team is seeking a Digital Experience Manager to serve as the human judgment layer at the center of our AI-powered content ecosystem. Generative AI has transformed how content is created, discovered, and consumed.

The durable differentiator is now strategic direction: the taste, standards, brand intelligence, and systematic thinking that ensures our digital properties deliver engaging sustainability content—not just to human readers, but to the AI models and generative engines that increasingly mediate how the world finds information.

This role supports the digital strategy for two flagship properties: theclimatepledge.com and sustainability.aboutamazon.com, with a core focus on Generative Engine Optimization (GEO). You will partner directly with editorial and channels to ensure content is optimized for AI discoverability, bring the annual Sustainability Report to life across these properties and AI search alike.

The right candidate sits at the intersection of generative AI search, content strategy, and digital operations—equally comfortable producing AI-assisted content, building creative prototypes, and managing day-to-day site operations including the SIM ticket queue.

This role suits a self-starter with bias for action, high editorial standards, and excellent analytical skills to translate performance data into roadmap recommendations.


Key job responsibilities
GEO & Content Strategy
- Partner with editorial to ensure stories, features, and site content are structured and optimized based on GEO principles—maximizing citation and surfacing in AI-powered search and LLM outputs
- Craft and execute a third-party citation share strategy
- Define and maintain content quality standards that serve as the brand intelligence layer for AI-generated and AI-assisted content—the signals, thresholds, and editorial guardrails that ensure our content builds brand authority, not just traffic
- Monitor the evolving AI search landscape—including LLM behavior, AI Overviews, and generative search experiences—and adapt content strategy to maintain visibility and accuracy
- Conduct content audits through a GEO lens: identify gaps across Amazon’s portfolio of sustainability-related content where information is not being surfaced by AI models, and develop remediation strategies
- Advise on how the brand should interact with generative AI systems—what great AI-assisted content workflows look like, and how to surface AI capabilities in ways that are trustworthy and editorially sound

AI Creative Production & Prototyping
- Produce high-quality content independently across modalities—including web copy, image, and video—using leading AI creation tools with hands-on fluency
- Build working creative prototypes that demonstrate new content experiences, surface trade-offs, and create decision points for creative, editorial, and program leadership
- Translate creative vision into actionable direction for AI-assisted workflows: define what great looks like when AI is part of the content creation process
- Evaluate AI-generated outputs with a critical creative eye—providing feedback on quality, accuracy, and brand alignment that can inform model improvement and editorial standards
- Stay current with emerging AI tools and techniques; bring a point of view on which tools and workflows should be adopted to scale content production without sacrificing quality

Digital Operations & Partnerships
- Manage the day-to-day operations of our flagship digital properties, including the SIM queue, content updates, quality assurance, and publishing workflows
- Serve as the primary lead for website workstreams that support reporting and disclosures, including the annual Sustainability Report
- Leverage analytics and performance data to surface actionable insights, influence the site roadmap, and drive measurable improvements in content engagement and AI discoverability
- Coordinate cross-functional timelines between web, design, editorial, and reporting stakeholders to ensure content launches on schedule

Basic qualifications

- Experience using content management systems and content tools
- Experience working with stakeholders, or experience working in a large team or fast-paced corporate environment
- Bachelor's degree in communications, marketing, advertising or business
- 3+ years of experience in digital content strategy, web operations, digital marketing, or a hybrid creative/technology role
- Strong understanding of SEO fundamentals and emerging GEO principles—how AI models surface, summarize, and cite web content
- Strong writing and editing skills with the ability to distill complex topics into clear, engaging, GEO-optimized web content

Preferred qualifications

- Demonstrated experience with AI content creation tools—including generative AI for copy, image, or video
- Experience working at the intersection of creative and technology—collaborating with engineering, product, or data science teams to build or improve content systems
- Proficiency with design tools (Figma, Adobe Creative Suite) to refine, annotate, and communicate creative direction alongside AI-generated outputs
- Experience managing production cycles for large-scale editorial or publishing projects (e.g., annual reports, campaign launches)
- Proficiency with web analytics platforms (Adobe Analytics, Semrush, Google Search Console) and data-informed content strategy
- A genuine interest in sustainability, climate, or environmental topics

descriptionHtml:
Sr. Sustainability Specialist within the Global Clean Fuels (GCF) program under Worldwide Operations Sustainability (WWOS). Owns techno-economic and lifecycle assessment modeling for low-carbon fuel pathways, develops and manages a portfolio of technology pilots, and translates technical analysis and pilot results into investment recommendations that drive Amazon's fuel decarbonization strategy across its global transportation network.

Key job responsibilities
Techno-Economic Analysis & Lifecycle Assessment
- Own bottom-up, process-based TEA models for multiple LCF pathways; apply learning rates and scenario analysis across key cost drivers to forecast cost trajectories and inform go/no-go investment decisions
- Conduct lifecycle carbon intensity analyses using established LCA frameworks and carbon accounting standards to guide feedstock and technology selection
- Advance TEA/LCA methodologies and build scalable analytical infrastructure and decision frameworks that grow with the program's fuel volumes, pathways, and geographic scope

Technology Pilot Portfolio Management
Manage a portfolio of concurrent LCF technology pilots across multiple TRL stages:
- Run stage-gate reviews from scoping through pilot to scale-up decision; translate results into updated TEA/LCA projections with go/no-go recommendations
- Coordinate timelines, partner deliverables, and funding across cross-functional stakeholders
- Build scalable playbooks for technology evaluation and pilot management

Feedstock & Supply Analysis
- Model feedstock availability, cost curves, and sustainability across supply chains; evaluate novel feedstocks for CI impact and scalability
- Model delivered costs across geographies to inform deployment sequencing

Program Leadership & Influence

- Mentor sustainability specialists and analysts; participate in hiring and promotion

WWOS sets the strategy and interim targets for Amazon Operations to achieve the Climate Pledge, which is our commitment to net-zero carbon by 2040. WWOS coordinates across all regions and business units, driving resource allocation and decision-making on sustainability topics that span the global operations network.

Within WWOS, the GCF program leads Amazon's effort to decarbonize its transportation and distribution network through LCF adoption globally. The team evaluates emerging fuel technologies, manages producer partnerships and technology pilots, and builds the techno-economic frameworks that drive investment decisions.

- Experience in quantitative role (engineering, process re-engineering, quality assurance), or experience building and managing financial models for business forecasting and problem solving
- 5+ years of experience in energy, fuels, or sustainability
- Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Chemistry, Environmental Science, or a related quantitative field
- Direct experience using and driving decisions from LCA or carbon-accounting methods
- Experience communicating technical analysis and recommendations to business or investment decision-makers

title: Engineering Operation Technician
descriptionHtml:
Join our dynamic team and become a critical guardian of technological infrastructure! As a Data Center Engineering Technician, you'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of mission-critical technology infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that power global digital experiences. Your expertise will directly contribute to maintaining an extraordinary 99.999% uptime, keeping the digital world running smoothly and efficiently.

Engineering Technicians are Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot, Data Center Operation’s Mission Critical Facilities, which includes stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, as well as three phase electrical systems such as: switch gear, UPSs, PDUs, wet cell batteries and associated systems, CRAC, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers/water chemical system, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, & motors.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.
NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.



Key job responsibilities
- Daily building rounds to monitor and record information from electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment to ensure 24/7 reliability and availability
- Monitor Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Management System (EPMS)
- Assist in troubleshooting of facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA)
- Perform rack installs and rack decommissioning within internal SLA
- Perform PM, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and repair of electrical and mechanical equipment
- Technical writing to support change management program
- Monitor daily work requests and manage to resolution, and execute projects from conception to completion
- On-site support of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation
- Work schedule changes depending on specific site needs. Shifts can be up to 12-hours and may rotate on a predefined schedule. Some locations have on-call rotations.
- Role may support more than one location/site.

Physical Requirements:
- Willingness and demonstrated ability to work in the following physical conditions with reasonable accommodations:
- Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds independently
- Participate in group lifts for 40+ pounds
- Maintain balance and perform construction tasks while on a ladder
- Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl, climb stairs, twist, bend, work above shoulders, grasp, carry, push and pull objects into position
- Work in an environment requiring provided ear protection

This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.

Essential Requirements:
- Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed
- Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational
- Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility

Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs.



A day in the life
This role acts as Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment preventative maintenance (PM) and troubleshooting, reporting to a site’s Data Center Facility Manager (FM). They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot mission-critical data center facility equipment including stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, 3 phase electrical systems such as switchgear, UPS units, PDUs, and wet cell batteries and associated systems. Mechanical equipment includes CRAHU units, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers, water systems, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, and motors. Additional support equipment is included in the scope of the role which includes fire/life safety equipment, building automation systems, and general facilities equipment.

Basic qualifications

- 2+ years of electrical and mechanical facilities maintenance, or 2+ years of electrical facilities maintenance and 1+ years of mechanical facilities maintenance experience
- 2+ years of Microsoft Office products and applications experience
- Work flexible schedule including weekends, nights, and holidays

Preferred qualifications

- 2+ years of data center engineering experience
- Experience reading and writing procedures, technical documents, and engineering drawings
- vocational/technical training or an associate degree or above, or 4+ years of military experience

title: Risk Manager, Customer Safety Insights & Investigations
descriptionHtml:
The Customer Safety Insights & Investigations (CS2I) team within RISC is looking for a Risk Investigator to lead high-judgment, high-impact investigations into potential product safety hazards. The cases you will handle are often time-sensitive, complex, and require coordination across multiple teams, including Legal, Policy, Operations, and regional safety partners.

You will review nuanced safety incidents, analyze evidence from multiple sources, and determine whether a product poses a meaningful risk to customers. Many of the escalations you will own are high visibility and may involve sensitive customer experiences, safety hazards, or potential liability exposure. Your work directly helps prevent recurrence of safety issues and strengthens customer trust in Amazon’s stores.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving intricate problems, thrives in ambiguity, and wants to play a key role in protecting customers at scale.


Key job responsibilities
Investigation & Case Leadership
- Own the end-to-end investigation of complex, urgent, and sensitive product safety escalations.
- Combine customer reports, product details, incident data, and expert guidance to determine what happened and what the appropriate action should be.
- Navigate ambiguity with high judgment, applying consistent logic while adapting to the nuances of each case.
- Document findings clearly and maintain audit-ready case files.

Deep Analytical Problem Solving
- Conduct thorough deep dives that uncover root causes, contributing factors, or early indicators of broader concerns.
- Synthesize evidence from multiple sources to reach accurate conclusions, even when data is incomplete.
- Identify patterns in cases that may warrant additional follow-up by partner teams.

Cross-Functional Collaboration
- Work closely with Legal, Product Compliance, Operations, and policy subject-matter experts to validate findings or gather additional perspective.
- Engage with international teams to ensure alignment on cases that span regions or require localized interpretation.
- Communicate concisely and professionally to drive timely resolution of high-impact cases.

Customer-Focused Decision-Making
- Apply sound judgment to recommend mitigations that prioritize customer safety.
- Ensure decisions follow Amazon’s policies and balance customer impact with business considerations.
- Move with speed and accuracy, especially during time-sensitive escalations.

Continuous Improvement & Ownership
- Identify opportunities to streamline investigation workflows while maintaining high quality.
- Share learnings with peers to improve team consistency and strengthen overall safety mechanisms.
- Demonstrate ownership by proactively closing gaps and anticipating next steps in complex investigations.

A day in the life
You begin by triaging urgent safety escalations from multiple regions. Throughout the day, you analyze images, review claims, read customer reports, and consult with Legal or Compliance SMEs when a case presents new nuances. You may work with investigators in other geographies to align on the interpretation of evidence. You complete several high-quality investigations, document your findings, and highlight insights that may inform broader safety discussions within the team.

About the team
CS2I investigates product safety concerns, interprets complex signals, and partners across Amazon to drive actions that protect customers. Our investigators handle some of the most sensitive and high-impact safety cases across Amazon’s global stores. We value curiosity, high judgment, clear communication, and a strong commitment to customer safety.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- 4+ years of compliance program management, legal, governance, audit, risk/loss prevention, or equivalent experience
- Experience handling confidential information
- Experience in data analysis and leveraging analytics to make decisions

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of program requirements definition and data and metrics leveraging to drive improvements experience
- Professional auditing qualification, or similar risk or compliance credentials
- Experience with SQL and Excel
- Experience prioritizing and handling multiple assignments at any given time while maintaining commitment to deadlines, or experience in a fast-paced, high-tech company

title: RME Technician (Mechanical) , Reliability Maintenance Engineering
descriptionHtml:
The Maintenance Technician (Mechanical) plays a key role in ensuring the mechanical reliability and operational continuity of conveyor systems, material handling equipment, and rotating machinery within our IST2 Fulfillment Center. This position is responsible for performing preventive and corrective maintenance on a wide range of mechanical components including bearings, motors, gearboxes, belts, rollers, and conveyor systems. The technician will work closely with engineers and other RME teams to minimize equipment downtime and support continuous improvement initiatives.

Key job responsibilities
• Perform preventive and corrective maintenance on conveyor systems, motors, gearboxes, reducers, belts, rollers, and bearings.
• Diagnose and troubleshoot mechanical failures on material handling and rotating equipment.
• Execute planned maintenance tasks according to CMMS work orders and preventive maintenance schedules.
• Conduct bearing replacements, belt tensioning and alignment, roller and idler changes, and gearbox oil services.
• Perform motor coupling alignments, V-belt and chain drive maintenance, and shaft/seal replacements.
• Collaborate with engineers and other RME teams to support equipment upgrades and reliability improvement projects.
• Assist in root cause analysis for mechanical failures and develop corrective action plans.
• Document all work performed in the CMMS system, including parts used and time spent.
• Ensure compliance with safety policies, procedures, lockout/tagout (LOTO) standards, and mechanical safety practices.

Basic qualifications

- Technical Diploma in Mechanical , Industrial Maintenance, or related field.
- Minimum 3 years of hands-on experience with industrial mechanical maintenance.
- Solid understanding of conveyor systems, power transmission components (bearings, gearboxes, couplings, belts, chains).
- Ability to read and interpret mechanical drawings and schematics.
- Proficient in using hand tools, precision measurement tools (calipers, dial gauges), and alignment equipment.
- Knowledge of LOTO (Lockout/Tagout) procedures and mechanical safety standards.
- Willingness to work shifts, weekends, or on-call as needed.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in high-volume manufacturing, logistics, or e-commerce fulfillment environments.
- Hands-on experience with conveyor belt systems, roller replacements, and sortation equipment.
- Knowledge of lubrication programs and bearing failure analysis.
- Familiarity with Computerized Maintenance Management Systems (CMMS).
- Experience with vibration analysis tools or basic condition monitoring techniques.
- Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
- Ability to work independently and as part of a cross-functional team.

title: Sr. Solutions Architect, AWS Industries, Energy & Utilities
descriptionHtml:
Imagine being a part of a team where your ideas can help reshape the future of the Energy industry and improve the lives of many. Here at Amazon Web Services (AWS), you'll work with a talented & inclusive team while using the latest technologies to help our customers accelerate the global energy transition.

We are looking for an experienced and motivated technologist who possess a deep understanding of the Energy & Utilities industry. You will have a business mindset, technical depth, and have strong interpersonal skills to build the future with us as a Solutions Architect - supporting one or some of the largest Energy companies in the world.

You will work with customer line of business owners to solve their biggest business problems and help them attain new levels of performance. You will leverage AWS’ leading AI and cloud services to craft highly scalable, flexible and resilient cloud architectures that address business problems and accelerate the customer cloud journey. These solutions always have the customer and their experience at the center of everything we do.

You will adeptly interact, communicate and partner with other teams at AWS such as product, marketing, and professional services, and represent your team to executive management. You possess a demonstrated ability to think strategically about business, products, and technical challenges. Your dynamism, creativity and passion for excellence will make a positive impact with your customer.

If you can educate AWS customers about the art of the possible, while inspiring the impossible, come build the future with us.


Key job responsibilities
As an AWS Solutions Architect, you will have ownership of the technical relationship with customers, making recommendations on security, cost, performance, reliability, operational efficiency and best-practice architectures.

Internally, you will be an advocate acting on behalf of the customer to help drive continual improvements to the AWS platform, sharing their needs and wants to inform the roadmap of AWS features and services. You will also help shape the future of the Solutions Architecture organisation by helping to hire, coach and mentor others.

In this role, your creativity will link technology to tangible solutions, with the opportunity to define or invent cloud-native reference architectures with the worldwide AWS Solutions Architect community. You will participate in the creation and sharing of best practices, technical content and new reference architectures (e.g. white papers, code samples, blog posts) and evangelise and educate about AWS technology (e.g. through workshops, user groups, meetups, public speaking, online videos or conferences).

A day in the life
There is no typical day. A representative week includes leading a 2-hour architecture review with the customer's platform engineering team on data lake modernization, driving deep technical discussions on design trade-offs. You'll spend a day on-site at the customer's office conducting discovery sessions with new business units, having lunch with the VP of Digital to discuss their AI roadmap and influence strategic direction. Mid-week, you'll build and refine a generative AI pilot using RAG architecture for power network assets predictive maintenance, sync with your account team to align on messaging, and brief specialist teams on complex workloads. You'll present Well-Architected reviews to the customer's cloud center of excellence, write competitive displacement patterns for peer Solutions Architects, participate in hiring debriefs, and lead community sessions to share reference architectures that scale beyond your direct delivery.

About the team
The AWS Industries team is committed to helping industry customers enable their digital transformation journeys. Our primary goal is to meet customers where they are in their AI and cloud journey and work backwards from their industry specific needs to transform their business and their entire industry. Our team speaks the language of our industry customers, which means that we focus on business outcomes and industry use cases on behalf of our customers, whether that is how we build products and solutions, how we sell, how we deliver, or how we partner.

Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

title: Software Development Manager, AI Foundations, Amazon Leo AI Foundations
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is Amazon's initiative to launch a constellation of low Earth orbit satellites to provide low-latency, high-speed broadband connectivity to unserved and underserved communities around the world.

The Leo AI Foundations team builds the intelligence that will run Leo as an AI-native business. We combine applied science and engineering with Leo's domain expertise, own the shared AI foundation for the business, and lead work that spans teams and systems, so that progress in one part of Leo becomes a capability the whole business can use. Leo Lens is our command center for this AI network. It is pioneering agentic AI for diagnostics, reporting, troubleshooting and mitigating issues across our end-to-end network stack, and it automates workflows for mission operations, ecommerce and developer use cases. Through Lens, it is our vision that agents work as one system to keep the network secure and reliable, resolving failures before customers experience them, while Leo's teams keep authority over consequential decisions.

We are looking for a Software Development Manager to build and lead one of our engineering teams. You will own a roadmap in one of our tracks as we build the infrastructure for the AI that operates the network, from the agents themselves to the orchestration, knowledge access, evaluation and security controls that connect them. You will hire and grow a team of software engineers and applied scientists, partner with the domain teams that own satellites, gateways, customer terminals and network services, and deliver production systems where reliability, security and measurable impact are the bar.

Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Key job responsibilities
- Build, lead and develop a team of software engineers and applied scientists, from hiring and onboarding through career growth and performance.
- Own the team's roadmap and delivery: translate the AI Foundations charter into goals, milestones and launches, and report progress and risks to senior leadership.
- Lead the technical design and architecture of agentic AI systems for Leo, covering agent development, data integration and the platform services that connect agents to Leo's knowledge and systems.
- Bring deep, current knowledge of AI, including large language models, agent frameworks, retrieval and evaluation methods, and apply it to guide the team's technical choices and to raise the AI fluency of the partner teams you work with.
- Deliver production AI systems with the evaluation, access controls and operational readiness required to act on a live network, and expand agent autonomy only as evidence shows it is safe and effective.
- Own end-to-end delivery of complex, multi-team initiatives, including infrastructure migrations and platform improvements, with domain teams who retain ownership of their services.
- Set and uphold the engineering bar for the team: design and security reviews, testing, operational excellence and on-call health.
- Make prioritization calls in an ambiguous, fast-moving environment, balancing stability against new capabilities, and communicate trade-offs clearly.

A day in the life
No two days look the same, because you are building something that has not existed before. You will set the direction for your team and remove what stands in its way. You will sit with the engineers and scientists who own Leo's satellites, gateways, customer terminals and network services, and decide with them how your team's expertise in AI can unblock them or move them faster. You will meet the operators who keep the network healthy and turn their hardest problems into the next capability Lens delivers. You will hire and grow the people who build this, and represent your work to Leo's senior leadership.

About the team
We are an AI-native team of software engineers and applied scientists in Redmond, and we move fast. We use AI in how we build, not only in what we build, so a good idea can be a working experiment the same week and a production capability the next. We think beyond how things have been done, test our ideas against real problems, and keep only what proves itself. We ship lightning fast, and we hold a high bar for quality and production readiness while doing it.

- 3+ years of engineering team management experience
- 7+ years of engineering experience
- 8+ years of leading the definition and development of multi tier web services experience
- 1+ years of providing technical leadership and project management for all aspects of the software development lifecycle experience
- 1+ years of developing large-scale, multi-tiered distributed software systems using Java, C#, or C++ experience
- 1+ years of developing large-scale, multi-tiered distributed software systems using service-oriented architecture experience
- 1+ years of developing large-scale, multi-tiered distributed software systems using distributed programming experience
- 5+ years of Software Engineer, Software Developer, or related occupational experience
- Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
- Knowledge of engineering practices and patterns for the full software/hardware/networks development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, certification, and livesite operations
- Experience partnering with product or program management teams
- Experience delivering production systems built on large language models or ML, including evaluation, guardrails and cost management

- Conduct and oversee generator preventive maintenance, fluid sampling (oil, coolant, fuel), load bank testing, and emissions stack testing to OEM, NFPA 110, and air permit requirements, and NDT of switchgear and transformers
- Develop and implement standard operating procedures for generator maintenance and testing and NDT inspection programs
- Train technicians on generator maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair, and on NDT methods including infrared thermography and partial discharge analysis
- Establish performance benchmarks for generator systems, analyze NDT and fluid sampling trends, and prepare reports on testing results and maintenance activities
- Communicate technical findings and risk from NDT and generator performance data to facility management and stakeholders
- Collaborate with facility managers and vendors to coordinate generator maintenance schedules, stack testing, NDT programs, and OEM repairs
- Ensure compliance with safety procedures, including NFPA 70E and LOTO, during generator maintenance and NDT operations
- Maintain detailed records of generator maintenance, fluid sampling, stack test results, and NDT results using facility management software and Microsoft Office tools
- Perform rotational on-call duties as the after-hours Services Team Manager for the data centers in the region, including responding to generator failures, NDT anomalies, and other site issues, and managing the investigation, mitigation, and recovery of the issue(s)

A day in the life
The Services Team Chief Engineer is Amazon's front-line specialist for generator systems and non-destructive testing (NDT) of electrical equipment in mission-critical data center facilities that must maintain better than 99.999% uptime. Primary equipment responsibilities include standby diesel generators and NDT of critical 3-phase electrical infrastructure. The Chief Engineer leads and trains technicians in generator maintenance, troubleshooting, emissions stack testing, and emergency operations and in NDT procedures (including thermography and partial discharge analysis), while developing comprehensive training programs for these core areas. Project management is essential to the role, including oversight of generator upgrades and repairs and implementation of NDT programs. The Chief Engineer collaborates with engineering teams, NDT specialists, and vendors both locally and globally while maintaining independent project management responsibilities. They establish project milestones, manage procurement of specialized equipment and components, track costs, and document best practices for implementation across Amazon's global data center network.

descriptionHtml:
Job description
AWS is looking for a Network Deploy Technician to join our growing team within infrastructure operations. You will work with minimum supervision in a dynamic environment to drive the stability and sustainability of our next-generation networks and assist in the development of innovative ways to automate and scale our network.

The position's responsibilities include scaling support of several data center locations and day to day assistance with capacity management. You will work closely with internal customers and external vendors to facilitate smooth project execution as directed by Network Leadership and Technical Project Managers.

You will leverage your experience supporting large scale, enterprise class networks as well as network implementation and troubleshooting. As a Network Deploy Technician, you will work in a fast paced, collaborative environment with regular peer and customer interaction. In addition to providing management and support of AWS’ vast network infrastructure, Network Deploy Technicians establish and follow best practices and refine operational procedures.

All physical requirements are expected with reasonable accommodations:
• Regularly lift and/or move up to 40 pounds; and participate in group lifts for 41+ pounds
• Ability to work in an environment that operates 24/7 with an ability to participate in primary responder rotation and provide after-hours support as needed
• Working in cramped and/or elevated and/or noisy environments
• Bending, lifting, stretching, reaching, standing and walking for up to 8+ hours a day
• Ascending and descending ladders, stairs, and gangways safely and without limitation

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Key job responsibilities
• Managing work and priorities through ticketing system and workflows to complete customer requests and projects
• Collaborating with various stakeholders to remove project obstacles
• Troubleshooting networking, routing and interconnectivity issues, including patch panels and patch cords
• Specifying Power and Cooling requirements and ensuring Hardware Racking/Stacking completed for new equipment
• Participating in the migration, basic configuration and rollout of new or upgraded hardware

Traveling within and outside of regional work area is required. You will be responsible for having a reliable personal vehicle and valid driver's license to travel within the regional work area, as company transportation will not be provided.

A day in the life
Our team has three primary tasks:
1. Providing the first level networking devices to serve our customer racks entails various tasks (the name of the game is efficiency): You will track network rack intake and delivery; work with various onsite teams to request for rack space, power, and cooling for network racks. 2. There is also console builds (and room builds) that are really exciting. You'll be exposed to more teams whose goal is to provide more space and capacity for customer racks.
3. Work with ID-Scaling peers to build higher-level networking devices.

- 1+ years of computer networking experience

title: Senior Regional EHS Manager
descriptionHtml:
At Amazon, we prioritize health, safety, and well-being above all else. There is nothing more important. To support this priority, Amazon is seeking an experienced and innovative Senior Regional Workplace Health and Safety (WHS) Manager to join our team. In this position, you will be responsible for partnering with a regional operations team to execute company WHS policies and ensure compliance to all applicable local, regional and federal regulations. By leveraging lean principles and kaizens, you will lead continuous improvement initiatives to reduce conditional and ergonomic risk to ensure a safe and healthful working environment for Amazon’s Associates.

In this role, you must demonstrate the ability to build trust and confidence with the cross functional operations teams, and influence change through providing comprehensive risk assessments and safety data analysis. To do so, you must be an effective communicator and send clear, concise and consistent messages, both verbally and in writing. You will also be required to instruct and train operations leadership and site WHS professionals in company EHS policies while assisting the regional teams in incorporating our safety standards at their sites. Your experience working in safety programs and your relevant safety, environmental and ergonomic knowledge in an operations environment will be crucial.

You will be responsible for developing a team of safety managers and safety professionals within your designated region. Your teams’ success will depend on your ability to create and execute leadership development plans for your larger team. You must demonstrate your ability to clearly communicate organizational direction through your team and give frequent and appropriate feedback to your WHS teams while ensuring they are executing to the core competencies of an Amazon WHS professional. As a senior leader in the WHS organization, you will also be responsible for judging and assessing safety talent to select appropriate bench strength for current and future business needs.

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:
- Act as SME of local/regional regulations and company WHS policy.
- Provide guidance and oversight to ensure compliance to all applicable Amazon WHS Policies.
- Measure the regions and sites’ performance against published requirements in WHS policies. For all deficiencies, identify a plan for the site to implement and fix all identified deficiencies.
- Ensure WHS recordkeeping and data integrity and provides Operations with accurate reporting and metrics to support business WHS initiatives.
- Deliver on-time and quality projects to Operations. Deliver quality projects on time to Operations.
- Analyze WHS metrics and review incident weekly and monthly incident trends to discover trends to justify the allocation of appropriate resources to areas where the safety risk is highest.
- Analyze Global Safety Peer Review results and develop and implement solutions to eliminate exposure to these risks and prevent injury at other FCs.
- Audit recordkeeping practices and Global WHS Database entries to ensure compliance to global WHS standards and local regulations.
- Audit the workplace organization and Associate behaviors to ensure that training, auditing and scoring methods are accurate and consistent.
- Manage and mentor the FC WHS Manager and WHS Associates in your assigned FCs.
- Spend time at the fulfillment centers and seek input from WHS teams, Associates and leaders on WHS program improvement opportunities. Ensure open communication on status of progress and resolution against these suggestions.
- Lead soft tissue injury reduction efforts by performing targeted Kaizens in partnership with the Operations teams based on the risks identified in each task (force, repetition, and awkward postures).

title: シフトアシスタント
descriptionHtml:
※このポジションの勤務地は福岡県粕屋郡を予定しています。

私たちのグローバルオペレーションネットワークは、日々何百万もの荷物と笑顔をアマゾンのお客様にお届けしています。私たちは、シフトアシスタントとして私たちのチームに加わってほしいと考え、意欲的で顧客重視の人材を探しています。この役割では他業種・職種も含めこれまでの経験、スキルを活かし、改善点を模索しながら、より便利でお客様に満足いただける高い品質のサービスを提供できるビジネスをつくる事、安全・快適・楽しい職場環境の構築を行う、将来の組織のリーダーを目指していただける事を期待しています。また、お客様の注文が適切な時間に適切な場所へ確実に配送されるよう、お客様の期待に応えることにおいても重要な役割を担います。

私たちの業務の流れには3つの主要な要素があります。
商品が保管され注文に備える「ファーストマイル」、注文品をお客様のエリアまで輸送する「ミドルマイル」、そして商品をお客様の玄関先までお届けする「ラストマイル」です。各拠点で運営方法に若干の違いはありますが、一貫して変わらないものが一つあります、それは顧客を第一に考える私たちのビジョンと献身的な姿勢です。

本ポジションはアマゾンの新しいエキサイティングな配送拠点で業務を行います。可能な限り最速でお客様のご自宅に商
品をお届けすることでお客様のカスタマーエクスペリエンスを向上します。私たちと一緒に歴史をつくりましょう！


■業務内容■
具体的にはマネージャーのサポートのもと、以下の業務に責任をもち遂行いただきます。

① 安全・品質・作業効率の向上
安全安心な作業環境の維持・向上のため、日々の安全活動、品質チェックに加え、標準作業手順書の作成や多岐にわたる問題解決・改善活動を行います。

② 日々のオペレーション対応
商品を入荷、在庫として管理し、注文があった商品を出荷するという一連の流れを各工程間で連携をとりながら、業務を円滑に進める事が求められます。お客様とお約束した期日までに商品を迅速かつ正確にお届けするため、時間ごとの計画に沿ってオペレーションを実施することに責任を持ちます。

③ 新規プロジェクトの導入・セール時など、オペレーション拡大時の準備
新しいサービスやシステムの導入に備え、現場での手順変更・導入方法を検討し円滑な導入に向けて準備を行います。また、新規入職者でもAmazonの標準作業に則った手順がスムーズに身につくためのトレーニング構築やマニュアルを作成します。

④ イレギュラーへの対応
作業で発生する様々な課題の原因を追求し問題解決を行います。また、再発防止策案の検討、実施を行います。
※上記業務はマネージャーやチームのサポートのもと実施していただきます

※社内公募により、マネージャーへのキャリアアップや他部署への異動機会もあります
※勤務は交代制（夜勤あり）です

入社後、約1週間はAmazonのリーダーとして必要な会社のカルチャーや、配送拠点の基本的な業務を一通り学ぶことができる座学の機会を提供します。各部署へ配属後は、トレーナーのもと、OJTで工程知識やツールの使用方法など基礎知識を学んでいきます。トレーニング資料も完備しており、相互に進捗を確認しながら独り立ちまでしっかりとサポートしますので、未経験者も安心してスタートができる環境です。

title: Business Intelligence Engineer, FCGT
descriptionHtml:
The International Seller Services Analytics team for WW Reimbursements is looking for a Senior Business Intelligence Engineer to lead advanced analytics for our Product and Business teams. You'll bring together large, multi-dimensional datasets across reimbursement claims, inventory discrepancies, and seller settlements to build data models and insights that drive high-impact decisions. As part of the International Seller Services Analytics team, you'll partner with business, finance, and engineering stakeholders to turn complex data into actions that protect seller trust and Amazon's financial accuracy. If you're customer obsessed, hands-on with SQL and Python, and energized by solving ambiguous problems at scale, this role is for you.

Key job responsibilities
The International Seller Services Analytics team for Amazon's Worldwide (WW) Reimbursements organization is seeking a talented, self-driven and experienced Senior Business Intelligence Engineer to lead the advanced analytics wing for the WW Reimbursements Product and Business team. This pivotal role gives you the opportunity to work with an exceptionally innovative team, slice and dice multi-dimensional, high-depth data across reimbursement claims, inventory discrepancies, and seller settlements, and build complex data models that drive data-driven insights for high-impact decisions spanning Seller and Customer experience, financial accuracy, and loss-prevention Product/Program initiatives.

Are you customer obsessed, flexible, smart and analytical, strategic yet execution focused, and passionate about e-commerce and operational excellence? Are you an experienced, entrepreneurial leader with a strong work ethic? If yes, this opportunity will appeal to you.

To be successful in this role, you will have the ability to roll up your sleeves, innovate, and quickly become a subject matter expert on the reimbursement lifecycle, assessing performance across claim types, fulfillment channels, and marketplaces. You will be a self-starter who is willing to work hands-on, is comfortable with ambiguity and large data sets. You will be part of the International Seller Services Analytics team working with Stakeholders, Finance partners, Data Engineers, Business Intelligence Engineers and Business Analysts to achieve our goals. You will also have strong communication skills, be able to work closely with stakeholders, and translate data-driven findings into actionable insights that protect both seller trust and Amazon's financial integrity.

You will have demonstrated proficiency in SQL across a variety of databases, BI tools, and R or Python to analyze large data sets.

Key job responsibilities

Passionate about working with huge data sets and someone who loves to bring datasets together to answer business questions.
You should have deep expertise in the creation and management of datasets, with exposure to implementing and operating stable, scalable data flow solutions from production systems into end-user-facing applications/reports. These solutions will be fault tolerant, self-healing and adaptive.
Detail-oriented with an aptitude for solving unstructured problems, especially where reimbursement discrepancies, root-cause attribution, and financial reconciliation demand precision. You should work in a self-directed environment, own tasks and drive them to completion.
Excellent business and communication skills to work with business and finance owners to develop and define key business questions, and to build data sets that answer those questions across the WW Reimbursements space.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of analyzing and interpreting data with Redshift, Oracle, NoSQL etc. experience
- 2+ years of Tableau Desktop, Quicksight or other relevant data visualization software experience
- Experience with data visualization using Tableau, Quicksight, or similar tools
- Experience with data modeling, warehousing and building ETL pipelines
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, or a related field

Preferred qualifications

- Experience developing and presenting recommendations of new metrics allowing better understanding of the performance of the business

title: Associate Corporate Counsel, Amazon Leo
descriptionHtml:
Help shape the future of global connectivity.

Amazon Leo is building a constellation of Low Earth Orbit satellites designed to deliver low-latency, high-speed broadband access to underserved and unserved communities around the world. Amazon Leo is seeking a motivated Associate Corporate Counsel to support regulatory and policy advocacy efforts that help establish the legal and regulatory frameworks enabling this global connectivity mission.

As Associate Corporate Counsel, you will research, analyze, and help draft advocacy positions on emerging regulations and policy proposals affecting Amazon Leo's spectrum rights, satellite operations, and broadband service offerings worldwide. You will prepare consultation responses, regulatory comments, policy position papers, and legal analyses on topics including spectrum allocation and sharing, satellite licensing and landing rights, telecommunications legislation, earth station regulations, and broadband/ISP regulatory frameworks. You will work closely with regulatory affairs, public policy, and business teams to develop and advance Amazon Leo's policy positions before national regulators, multilateral bodies such as the ITU, and other standard-setting organizations across multiple jurisdictions.

This is an opportunity to work at the intersection of satellite technology, international telecommunications law, spectrum policy, and emerging regulatory frameworks within one of Amazon's most ambitious innovation initiatives. The role offers exposure to a truly global regulatory landscape spanning the Americas, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and Asia-Pacific.

Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.


Key job responsibilities
• Draft and support the preparation of consultation responses, regulatory comments, and advocacy filings before government regulators and international bodies worldwide
• Research and analyze proposed regulations, legislation, and policy frameworks affecting LEO satellite operations, spectrum access, and broadband service delivery
• Monitor and track regulatory developments across multiple jurisdictions, identifying emerging risks and opportunities
• Provide legal analysis on topics including spectrum management, satellite licensing regimes, landing rights frameworks, earth station regulations, ISP/telecom service authorizations, and interference coordination
• Collaborate cross-functionally with regulatory, public policy, government affairs, and business teams to align advocacy positions with Amazon Leo's commercial and operational objectives
• Support preparation for ITU World Radiocommunication Conferences (WRC) and regional spectrum coordination proceedings
• Help develop and maintain templates, processes, and institutional knowledge for the team's global advocacy portfolio


About the team
Amazon Leo's legal team sits at the intersection of new technology and highly regulated industries with a global footprint. We are a collaborative, mission-driven group of attorneys and legal professionals who partner closely with business teams to help build one of the most ambitious infrastructure projects in the world. Our work is fast-paced, intellectually stimulating, and deeply consequential — we are connecting communities that have never had reliable internet access. We value diverse perspectives, intellectual curiosity, and a willingness to tackle hard problems together.

Basic qualifications

- 2+ years of legal experience
- 2+ years of post bar admission legal experience
- Juris Doctor and membership in one state bar or equivalent
- Experience in private practice or in house experience at a technology company or equivalent

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in web services/cloud computing, software licensing, telecommunications or equivalent
- Knowledge of the ethical considerations surrounding AI in the legal context, such as confidentiality, accuracy, and bias prevention
- Experience managing multiple projects and meeting aggressive deadlines

title: Product Manager, Technical III, External Services, AWS Training and Certification
descriptionHtml:
AWS Applied AI Solutions (AAIS) is building toward a future where every business innovates with Amazon AI teammates. To get there, we build AI solutions that improve human capabilities and transform entire business functions. We create end-to-end products that surprise and delight out-of-the-box, making complex things easy and hard things possible, with no cloud experience required. We start with customers who embrace the future and build bridges to meet the rest where they are. We pursue ambitious opportunities with conviction, and we are looking for builders who share that mindset.

Are you excited about defining a new category of software, AI teammates that help people learn and grow in the flow of their work? Do you want to shape how millions of professionals build skills, earn certifications, and get better at their jobs every day? Do you want direct and immediate impact on the way people and AI learn together?

As part of the AWS Training and Certification team, we are building AI learning teammates: agentic systems that don't just answer questions or hand out courses, but work alongside people, notice where they are getting stuck, and turn everyday tasks into moments of learning. These teammates bring the right guidance, practice, and credential right into the tools and tasks they already use. This is a new product space where the right experience is still being invented, and we are looking for a product leader who partners deeply with design to define it.

As a Senior Product Manager - Technical, External Services, you will partner with design and lead the development of AI learning teammates, owning the product vision, requirements, and roadmap from concept through go-to-market. You will champion the needs of learners and the organizations that train and certify them, and translate ambiguous, open-ended problems into clear product definitions and detailed business requirements documents. You will work hand-in-hand with design, engineering, science, learning scientists, and operational stakeholders to prioritize the roadmap and spearhead the definition of new capabilities.

This role sits where product, learning, and design meet. A great learning teammate is built on more than a strong model and solid systems. It depends on trust, on clear interaction patterns, and on how it feels to be coached while you work. You will co-own the end-to-end experience with design. That spans how a teammate joins a team, how it surfaces learning in the flow of work, how it recognizes mastery and guides someone toward certification, and how people stay in control of their own development.

The successful candidate must have exceptional problem solving skills, strong business judgment, and demonstrated experience leading cross-functional teams. We are looking for a proven ability to execute both strategically and tactically, and someone who is excited to take on new, ambiguous projects that will be industry defining. This position requires a solid technical background, and the candidate should be customer-focused with a passion for learning, AI, agents, and the future of how skills are built.

AWS Training and Certification helps people and organizations build the cloud and AI skills they need to be successful, from foundational learning through role-based certifications recognized across the industry. As a member of this team, you'll support the development and management of AI-powered learning experiences that reach learners worldwide, including the agentic learning teammates that will define the next decade of how people grow their skills.

Key job responsibilities
- Partner with design to define and own the end-to-end experience for AI learning teammates, from onboarding and interaction patterns to how learning is delivered in the flow of work.
- Define product requirements and author business requirements documents that align engineering, design, science, learning scientists, and leadership around a shared vision for each capability.
- Own the roadmap for one or more learning teammate product areas, making trade-off decisions across competing priorities, customer commitments, and technical investments.
- Represent the product externally with enterprise customers, translating their workforce development and certification needs into product direction and measurable adoption goals.
- Drive cross-team alignment to ensure teammate capabilities are composable and reusable across the learning portfolio, partnering with learning science and certification stakeholders to keep in-the-flow experiences grounded in proven learning principles.

A day in the life
You might start your morning in a design review, working through the interaction model for how a teammate offers a quick coaching moment the instant someone hits a task they haven't done before. By midday, you are reviewing skill-progression and certification-completion metrics and preparing a decision narrative for leadership on a proposed new capability. In the afternoon, you connect with learning scientists and engineering to pressure-test whether an in-the-flow learning experience is effective and feasible this quarter, then close out by refining requirements for the next capability and drafting a narrative that will guide customer-facing conversations.

title: Security and Loss Prevention Specialist, NA
descriptionHtml:
Worldwide Operations Security (WWOS) is the global organization that supports field Security and Loss Prevention and is designed to support Amazon’s Worldwide Operations, as well as affiliate and retail businesses.

The Security and Loss Prevention Specialist (SLP Specialist) is a key hourly position within Amazon Operations. The SLP Specialist leads the effort to efficiently and effectively protect people, product and data (lives, physical property, equipment, inventory, data, & intellectual property) in a designated building. The SLP Specialist reports to the Security and Loss Prevention Cluster Manager responsible for their geographical area, and aids them in supporting the operational team, and cross functional teams throughout the organization.

Key job responsibilities
* Conduct confidential investigations and prepare prompt written reports of theft, fraud, and critical incidents
* Contribute to the identification of vulnerabilities (e.g., loss, associate experience, process improvement, data protection, physical security infrastructure) and define appropriate mitigating actions while ensuring compliance with legal and ethical standards
* Serve as department liaison and security/crisis management subject matter expert for site leadership keeping them informed on key issues, strategies, and the department’s performance
* Develop strategies for alarm reduction and conduct system diagnostic for problematic devices by engaging and resolving issues with internal and external partners
* Domestic regional travel up to 25% of the time when applicable.
* Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach; Stand/walk for up to 12 hours during shifts; Work in an environment where the noise level varies and can be loud; Work in an environment that is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments); Continuously climb and descend stairs (applies to sites with stairs).
* This role covers 24/7 operations and must be able to work all shifts, including nights, weekends, and holidays.

A day in the life
As a SLP Specialist, you will join a team of Security and Loss Prevention professionals providing security as a service to business customers across multiple business units within a dedicated geographical area. You will perform regular physical security audits and investigate policy violations, security-related incidents, and loss events. During your investigations, you collect information by monitoring systems and tools, analyzing data reports, and conducting interviews. Your findings help to identify vulnerabilities in our processes, and you contribute to developing mitigating measures to address them. You play a key role in maintaining the physical integrity of our fulfillment, logistics and retail operations locations by auditing and monitoring the health status of our systems with subject matter experts and external suppliers to maintain their functionality. You will interact on a daily basis with our external security service providers to ensure delivery of high-quality security services and a smooth customer experience. You also act as point of contact for multiple internal and external departments (e.g., legal, HR, security service providers, local law enforcement) and subject matter expert in Security and Loss Prevention-related matters. Finally, you deliver loss prevention-related education and awareness programs to other teams and liaise with various stakeholders on policy and procedure across all management levels.

About the team
Worldwide Operations Security (WWOS) is the global organization that supports field Loss Prevention and is designed to support Amazon’s Worldwide Operations, as well as affiliate and retail businesses, by creating and maintaining a work environment that is both prepared and secure through global security centers of excellence staffed by subject matter experts in people and asset protection. We accomplish this by creating policy and implementation guidelines; training leadership and staff; using technology to eliminate subjectivity, complexity, and variation; identifying, preparing for, and mitigating risk; and auditing our practices to ensure compliance.

Basic qualifications

- High school or equivalent
- 2+ years of Amazon (Blue Badge/FTE) experience, or 1+ year in security service, loss prevention, asset protection, investigations, law enforcement, or operations, or Loss Prevention Qualified Career Choice Graduate
- 1+ years of experience using Microsoft Office, including Excel, in a professional capacity
- Workplace incident mitigation or de-escalation and Business Continuity planning experience

Preferred qualifications

- Experience making and influencing informed decisions by leveraging data and metrics
- Demonstrated ability to work independently in a fast-paced and multi-tasking environment
- Ability to effectively communicate, collaborate, network and influence across all business levels in a diverse workforce environment
- 1+ year of leadership or management and/or supply chain experience
- Investigative interviewing experience; Wicklander and Zulawski, Loss Prevention Qualified, Certified Protection Professional, Loss Prevention Certified, Certified Forensic Interviewer, Certified Threat Assessment Certification or other relevant certifications
- Experience in physical security systems maintenance/implementation and coordinating scope of work with security vendors

title: SAP Finance Architect, AWS SAP Team
descriptionHtml:
We are seeking an experienced and highly skilled SAP Finance Architect to lead the implementation of the Finance and Control (FICO) module for our organization. The successful candidate will be responsible for configuring, customizing, and deploying the FICO module to support our financial accounting and management accounting processes. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in SAP Finance, with a strong understanding of end-to-end manufacturing and finance processes, including cost planning and actual costing. This role involves working closely with business stakeholders, IT teams, and implementation partners to design, configure, and support SAP solutions that drive financial transparency and operational efficiency.



Key job responsibilities
* Lead business process analysis and requirements gathering workshops with finance stakeholders to understand complex business needs.
* Design and architect robust, scalable, and compliant SAP FICO solutions, developing comprehensive blueprints and roadmaps from design to delivery.
* Configure and customize SAP FI/CO modules, including General Ledger (GL), Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), Asset Accounting (AA), Bank Accounting, Cost Center Accounting (CCA), Internal Orders, Product Costing (PC), and Profitability Analysis (CO-PA).
* Ensure seamless integration between SAP FICO and other core modules such as MM (Materials Management), SD (Sales and Distribution), PS (Project Systems), and PP (Production Planning).
* Oversee RICEFW (Reports, Interfaces, Conversions, Enhancements, Forms, Workflows) developments, collaborating closely with technical teams to ensure solutions meet functional specifications.
* Develop and manage data migration strategies, assisting with the extraction, transformation, and loading of financial data from legacy systems.
* Lead and support all project testing phases, including unit testing, integration testing, and User Acceptance Testing (UAT), to validate system functionality and data integrity.
* Develop comprehensive documentation, including functional specifications, process flows, configuration guides, and user manuals.
* Plan and deliver end-user training sessions and provide post-go-live support to ensure smooth system adoption and resolve issues promptly.
* Ensure the designed solutions comply with relevant accounting standards and regulations, such as US GAAP and IFRS.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
- 3+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience
- 3+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience
- Bachelor's degree
- Minimum of 3 years of experience in implementing and configuring the SAP FICO module, with a strong emphasis on financial accounting and management accounting processes.
- Understanding of accounting principles, financial reporting, and management accounting concepts.
- Functional knowledge of SAP FICO and its integration with other SAP modules (e.g., MM, SD, CO).

Preferred qualifications

- Experience working within software development or Internet-related industries
- Experience migrating or transforming legacy customer solutions to the cloud
- Experience working with AWS technologies from a dev/ops perspective
- Familiarity with accounting standards (e.g., GAAP, IFRS), industry regulations, and internal control frameworks.
- Knowledge of advanced financial reporting and consolidation processes.
- Familiarity with tax and compliance requirements in multiple jurisdictions (for multinational organizations).
- Certification in SAP FICO (e.g., SAP Certified Application Associate - Financial Accounting) is preferred.

title: Data Center Technician
descriptionHtml:
Join our dynamic AWS team and become a critical guardian of global cloud infrastructure! You'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of the world's most innovative technology platform, ensuring seamless data center operations that power millions of businesses and services worldwide.

Data Center Technicians should be willing to work both independently and with a team. Work prioritization, organizational skills, effective communication, and the ability to react quickly are critical to success. In addition to hardware and network repair, candidates will install equipment, create documentation, innovate solutions, and fix problems within the data center space. This team works in an environment that operates 24/7. Traveling within and outside of the regional work area is required.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.

NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.

Key job responsibilities
- Performing server rack installations, hardware break-fix on various components, troubleshooting network issues, and responding to operational incidents that impact service availability, escalating to senior technicians and management as needed/required
- Serving as a primary contact point for both internal and external stakeholders, including engineers, software developers, vendors, and contractors
- Performing on-call duties and participating in scheduled maintenance and change management activities
- Contributing to documentation and process improvement initiatives based on your analysis of operational issues
- Helping to train and onboard new team members

Physical requirements:

- Regularly lift and/or move up to 40 pounds; and participate in group lifts for 41+ pounds
- Working in cramped and/or elevated locations
- Bending, lifting, stretching, and reaching
- Standing and walking for up to 8+ hours a day
- Ascending and descending ladders, stairs, and gangways safely and without limitation
- Work in a noisy environment
- Work shifts longer than 8 hours to support 24/7 operations (covering both night and day shifts).

This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.

Essential Requirements:

- Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed
- Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational
- Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility

Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs.

A day in the life
As a Data Center Technician professional, you have industry-leading technical abilities and demonstrate a breadth of knowledge while you:
-Take ownership of technical issues brought by their customer base, engaging other teams when needed to drive resolution
-Solve problems at their root and step back to understand the broader context
-Maintain service level agreements through the implementation of proactive issue detection and reporting

You will be required to work shift work that will include days/nights/weekends/holidays. Traveling within and outside of the regional work area is required. You will be responsible for having a reliable personal vehicle and valid driver's license to travel within the regional work area, as company transportation will not be provided.

Basic qualifications

- 1+ years of computer/server hardware troubleshooting or related IT experience
- High school or equivalent diploma
- Work a flexible schedule including weekends, nights, and holidays

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge of network design, protocols and Layer 1/2 troubleshooting
- Associate's degree in a relevant field (e.g., Computer Science, Networking Engineering), or experience in a relevant field (e.g., Computer Science, Networking Engineering)
- Experience managing work and priorities through a ticketing system
- Experience in a data center or other critical environment

descriptionHtml:

In this role, you will serve as the primary technical point of contact for customers during their onboarding journey — guiding them through implementation, troubleshooting technical issues, translating customer needs into actionable engineering and program requirements, and acting as a technical Customer Success Manager.
This is a customer-facing role that demands strong technical depth across AWS services, excellent communication skills, and a project management mindset. You will be the bridge between customers and internal teams, ensuring a seamless onboarding experience while advocating for customer needs.

Key job responsibilities
Key Responsibilities

Customer Onboarding: Own end-to-end technical onboarding of customers onto Amazon Ads solutions, ensuring smooth and timely implementation.
Technical Troubleshooting: Diagnose and resolve technical issues across the AWS stack, working closely with customers and internal engineering teams to drive resolution.
Customer Advocacy: Act as the voice of the customer — collect and synthesize VOC (Voice of the Customer) feedback, and translate customer questions, pain points, and feature requests into engineering and program-level requirements.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with engineering, product, and program teams to drive resolution of customer issues and influence the product roadmap based on customer insights.
Technical Customer Success Management: Proactively monitor customer health, identify risks, and drive adoption by ensuring customers realize the full value of the solutions they are onboarding onto.
Documentation & Enablement: Contribute to onboarding runbooks, troubleshooting guides, and knowledge base articles to improve the onboarding experience at scale.
Project Management: Manage multiple customer onboarding engagements simultaneously, tracking milestones, dependencies, and deliverables to ensure on-time delivery.


Basic Qualifications

3+ years of experience in a Solutions Architect, Cloud Engineer, or similar customer-facing technical role.
Hands-on experience with AWS services, including:
AWS CloudFormation
Amazon S3
AWS Glue
Amazon Athena
Amazon EventBridge
AWS Lake Formation
AWS Clean Rooms

Proficiency in SQL and Python for data analysis, scripting, and automation.
Experience managing technical projects with multiple stakeholders and competing priorities.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting skills with a bias for diving deep into root causes.

Preferred Qualifications

Familiarity with Boto3 / AWS SDKs for programmatic AWS resource management.
Experience with privacy-enhancing technologies (PETs) or data collaboration concepts.
AWS Certification (e.g., AWS Solutions Architect – Associate or Professional).
Prior experience in a Customer Success, Technical Account Management, or Support Engineering role.
Experience working with cross-functional teams across different time zones.
Background in advertising technology or digital marketing platforms.

Leadership Principles Emphasized

Customer Obsession: You start with the customer and work backwards. You are relentless about earning and maintaining customer trust through every interaction.
Dive Deep: You operate at all levels, stay connected to the details, and audit frequently. No issue is beneath you when a customer needs help.
Bias for Action: You take swift, calculated action to unblock customers and drive progress — speed matters in onboarding.
Deliver Results: You own the customer onboarding outcome. You focus on the key inputs, track milestones, and deliver with the right quality in a timely manner, even in the face of setbacks.
Earn Trust: You listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat customers and colleagues with respect. You are transparent about challenges and proactive about solutions.

Much of your time is spent working directly with customer stakeholders, whiteboarding architectures, writing code, or refining solution designs that balance complexity, scale, and performance. You will regularly collaborate with delivery teams and AWS service teams, contributing to governance discussions and ensuring smooth handoffs from presales to delivery. Our culture is built on collaboration, empathy, and inclusion. We are committed to continuous learning and encourage every team member to grow, share knowledge, and contribute to an environment where creative problem-solving drives meaningful customer impact.
