title: Content Policy Counsel
descriptionHtml:
Amazon's Content Policy Legal Team is looking for a lawyer to advise on global content policy and online safety across Amazon's products and services.

In this role, you will partner with Amazon's public policy teams to analyse proposed content policy and online safety legislation around the world and develop Amazon's legal positions. As new laws take effect, you will advise teams across Amazon on compliance strategies and partner with product counsel and business teams to implement practical solutions. You will design legal approaches and build scalable processes that protect customers while allowing the business to move quickly. You will combine strong legal judgment and strategic thinking with practical experience in online safety law, content moderation, trust and safety, public policy, or regulatory compliance in the technology industry.

Key job responsibilities
- Track and analyse content policy and online safety legislation; assess impact to Amazon services and develop compliance strategies.
- Partner with product counsel and business teams to implement regulatory requirements, advising on content moderation policies, risk assessments, and operational controls.
- Advise Amazon services on content policies and compliance frameworks, and develop scalable guidance, playbooks, and resources for business teams, including building and implementing practical solutions and tools, which may include AI-powered applications.
- Support cross-Amazon policy initiatives, working with public policy, public relations, and business leadership to align positions on emerging trust and safety issues.

A day in the life
In a typical day you might interpret a newly introduced online safety bill and assess which Amazon services are affected, meet with a product team to advise on compliance controls for a content moderation workflow, draft a position document on an emerging regulatory issue for business and public policy stakeholders, and collaborate with legal colleagues across jurisdictions to align on a cross-Amazon compliance approach. You will work across many teams and many threads simultaneously.

About the team
The Content Policy Legal Team is a small group that provides subject matter expertise on content moderation, online safety, and trust and safety law across all of Amazon. We advise product counsel, public policy, and business leaders across dozens of services on content policy strategy, compliance, and risk mitigation — from child safety and harmful content to AI-generated content and emerging regulatory frameworks. We thrive on flexible, strategic thinking to keep up with the pace of technology, emerging risks, and a growing body of legislation.

Basic qualifications

- License to practice law in Europe, US or other common law jurisdiction
- Knowledge of internet, software, and media industries and the legal and regulatory environment in which they operate or equivalent
- Significant experience, with a minimum of 5+ years of post qualification experience

Preferred qualifications

- Experience of a mix of corporate law firm and in-house work
- Experience working closely with and advising senior executives of an organization or equivalent
- Experience managing multiple competing priorities simultaneously and driving goals to completion
- Experience with online safety, content moderation, or trust and safety law, including regulatory compliance programs, risk assessments, or subject matter depth in areas such as child safety or AI-generated content

title: Partner Management Coordinator, Prime Video Japan
descriptionHtml:
Prime Video Japan is one of the most exciting and fastest-growing streaming businesses in the world - and our Channels team sits right at the heart of it, bringing customers the subscription services they love inside a single, seamless Prime Video experience. We are expanding the team, and we are looking for an ambitious Partner Management Coordinator to grow with us.

This is a rare opportunity to build a career in partner management and business development from the ground up. You will own a meaningful slice of the Prime Video business end to end - serving as the go-to partner for finance and costing questions across our Japan Channel partners, and taking full ownership of our long-tail partner portfolio. These are your programs to run: you will keep partners happy, resolve their questions with speed and care, and ensure the business runs smoothly across a broad and diverse set of partners.

Just as importantly, you will have real room to make the role your own. We want someone who does not just execute the process, but improves it - spotting friction in how partner enquiries are handled, inventing simpler and faster ways of working, and raising the bar for the whole team. As you master the fundamentals, you will work shoulder-to-shoulder with our senior partner managers on our largest, most strategic partnerships, learning the craft of deal-making and partner growth and building a clear path toward becoming a Channels Partner Manager yourself.

If you are organized, commercially curious, energized by partners and numbers alike, and excited to grow in a dynamic, bilingual, globally-connected business - we would love to meet you.

A successful candidate will be:
- An owner at heart: You take a workstream and run with it.
- Commercially and numerically confident: You are at ease with costing, billing, and partner-facing financial detail
- A clear, trusted communicator: You handle partners and internal stakeholders with professionalism in both Japanese and English, and you know when to solve it yourself and when to escalate
- Genuinely customer-obsessed: You treat every partner enquiry with urgency and care, because a great partner experience is what keeps our business healthy
- An inventor, not just an operator: You see a clunky process and cannot help but improve it - you are always looking for the simpler, faster, better way
- Hungry to grow: You are excited to learn the Channels business inside out and build toward becoming a Channels Partner Manager

Key job responsibilities
Own partner finance and costing - end to end
- Be the trusted first point of contact for finance and costing enquiries from Channel partners across Japan, resolving questions with speed and accuracy and escalating the complex ones with good judgment
- Partner closely with internal Finance on billing, costing, and reconciliation, making sure partners always get a clear, correct, timely answer
Run the long-tail partner portfolio
- Take full ownership of the day-to-day for our long-tail Channel partners - contract administration, payments, and partner requests - keeping this part of the business running smoothly
Make the team faster and better
- Hunt for friction in how partner enquiries and long-tail partners are managed, and invent simpler, more scalable ways of working
- Keep partner trackers, CRM records, and reporting cadences accurate and sharp
Learn the craft and support growth
- Work alongside our senior partner managers on our strategic partnerships - preparing data, reporting, and reviews - and absorb the art of partner growth and deal-making
- Collaborate with Finance, Legal, and Advertising counterparts to move partner matters forward, building the cross-functional network that defines a great partner manager

A day in the life
Morning
- You open the partner finance queue, clear the routine costing questions partners have raised overnight, and flag the one tricky reconciliation for a senior partner manager - partners start their day with answers already waiting
- You reconcile a pending invoice query with Finance and update the portfolio tracker so the team has a single source of truth
- You join the team stand-up, bringing a quick read on where the long-tail portfolio stands this week
Midday
- A long-tail partner needs help on contract timing and payment - you own it start to finish and close the loop the same day
- You pull together the data and a crisp summary a senior partner manager needs ahead of a review with one of our largest partners, making their meeting sharper
- You spot that the finance-enquiry intake has been bouncing between inboxes - and you sketch a simpler routing that will save the team hours every week
Afternoon
- You scan the long-tail portfolio for anything at risk and draft a short, clear status note
- You sit in on a negotiation with a strategic partner, soaking up how our senior managers structure a deal - the craft you are building toward
- You write up your process improvement and share it with the team, raising the bar a little for everyone

About the team
Prime Video is a premium streaming entertainment service offering customers an unmatched breadth of content - from award-winning Prime Originals and exclusive licensed series to live sports, anime, and access to premium subscription channels.
Prime Video Channels enables customers to subscribe to curated third-party streaming services directly within the Prime Video experience - no additional apps, no long-term contracts - delivering exceptional convenience and selection. The Japan Channels team manages a vibrant portfolio of partner services, from our largest strategic partnerships to a broad long tail of specialist services. It is a close-knit, globally-connected, bilingual team where you will learn fast and have outsized impact.

Basic qualifications

- 1+ years of business development, partnership management, or sourcing new business experience
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
- Speak, write, and read fluently in Japanese
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English, and have the ability to take direction in English

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in business development, partner development, sales or alliances management
- Experience in program or project management

title: Applied Scientist, Superconducting Digital and Cryogenic Control Electronics,Center for Quantum Computing, Physical Design and Simulation, Enabling Technologies
descriptionHtml:
The Amazon Center for Quantum Computing (CQC) is seeking an Applied Scientist to research and design cryogenic control hardware for large-scale quantum processors, with an emphasis on superconducting digital circuits. Controlling and reading out orders of magnitude more qubits than today's systems demands rethinking where classical control lives and what technology implements it; you will design and model superconducting digital logic (e.g., single-flux-quantum-family circuits) and related cryogenic electronics, evaluate them against the wiring, power, and thermal budgets of a scaled system, and co-design control approaches with the qubit devices they serve. You will carry designs from concept through simulation, layout, design review, and fabrication handoff, and your evaluations will inform which control-electronics directions the organization invests in.

Key job responsibilities
• Design and simulate superconducting digital circuits and cryogenic control/readout electronics for scalable qubit control
• Develop and validate Josephson-junction circuit models, timing and margin analyses, and verification methodology for superconducting digital designs
• Quantify system-level trade-offs — wiring count, power dissipation at each cryogenic stage, latency, footprint — across candidate control architectures, and communicate recommendations
• Co-design control interfaces with qubit-device colleagues so control electronics and quantum devices are developed as one system
• Deliver design artifacts through the organization's design-request and design-review processes, including tapeout-ready layouts and verification reports
• Present results internally and, where appropriate, publish in peer-reviewed venues


About the team
The Enabling Technologies team develops technologies and relationships facilitating scaling, including alternative quantum processor architectures, superconducting qubit device packaging, and cryogenic control device electronics. We work alongside a co-located quantum processor design team focused on current-generation devices; the two teams share design and review processes, and moving ideas between them is an explicit part of our charter.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of building models for business application experience
- Experience in patents or publications at top-tier peer-reviewed conferences or journals
- Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language
- Experience in any of the following areas: algorithms and data structures, parsing, numerical optimization, data mining, parallel and distributed computing, high-performance computing
- Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining, a Master's degree or above in a relevant field
- Experience in patents or publications at top-tier peer-reviewed conferences or journals
- Experience with circuit design and simulation
- Familiarity with superconducting qubit control and readout — pulse generation, multiplexed readout, feedback latency requirements
- Experience designing superconducting digital circuits (RSFQ/ERSFQ, adiabatic quantum phase parametron, or related single-flux-quantum logic families), including Josephson-junction circuit simulation and margin analysis
- Experience with EDA flows for custom circuit design — schematic capture, layout, physical verification, and working against a process design kit

Preferred qualifications

- Experience using Unix/Linux
- Experience in professional software development
- Knowledge of cryogenic electronics more broadly: cryo-CMOS, low-temperature amplifiers and mixers, thermal and power budgeting across refrigerator stages
- Experience with microwave engineering and signal integrity in dense cryogenic interconnect
- Experience taking chips through fabrication and correlating measured circuit behavior with design models
- Familiarity with quantum error correction decoding and the classical-processing requirements it places on control systems

Unser Team ist menschenorientiert und hilfsbereit. Das ist besonders wichtig, weil viele unserer Mitarbeitenden in Nachtschichten arbeiten. Unser Fokus liegt vorwiegend auf dem operativen Betrieb. An den meisten unserer Standorte wird rund um die Uhr gearbeitet.
Unsere „Außendienst“-Mitarbeitenden arbeiten währenddessen mit Amazon Flex – einem Auftragnehmer-Netzwerk für die Lieferung. Jedes Jahr setzen wir neue Maßstäbe in puncto Kundenerlebnis und bieten neue, innovative Lieferdienste an. Wir suchen nach neuen Möglichkeiten, um branchenweite Logistikherausforderungen zu überwinden, sowie nach neuen Ideen, um unseren CO2-Fußabdruck zu reduzieren. title: FPGA Engineering Lead
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Web Services is seeking a FPGA Engineering Lead to drive FPGA architecture and implementation for deterministic real-time control, gate-drive timing and fast protection functions in the SST platform.

As a FPGA Engineering Lead you will own FPGA architecture: defining deterministic FPGA architecture for real-time control, gate-drive timing and fast protection where latency and safe-state behavior must be derived, not inherited. You will own VHDL/Verilog implementation and verification of ns-level timing, PWM interfaces and protection logic, plus escalation-grade bring-up issues. You will also drive FPGA/RTL and verification standards, correlate behavior to control models and lab data, and align interfaces with controls, protection and power-stage teams.



Key job responsibilities
FPGA architecture:
- Define FPGA architecture for real-time control functions and protection loops.
- Develop deterministic timing architectures for gate-drive and power-conversion functions.
- Define FPGA interfaces with DSP, embedded software, sensors, protection and power-stage electronics.
- Coordinate FPGA architecture with the overall hierarchical control strategy.

Implementation:
- Develop and review VHDL and/or Verilog implementations.
- Use Vivado or equivalent FPGA development environments.
- Implement timing-critical logic, PWM/control interfaces and protection functions.
- Support hardware bring-up, debugging and system integration.

Verification:
- Define FPGA verification strategies for timing, protection and control functions.
- Support fault-injection and system-level validation where appropriate.
- Correlate FPGA behavior with control models and laboratory measurements.
- Document FPGA requirements, architecture and verification evidence.

SST System Alignment:
- Implement deterministic state-machine, protection and control functions supporting SST operating states, startup/shutdown and fault recovery.
- Support VRT/FRT response, fast LVDC regulation/protection, overload response and power-sharing controls with the embedded/control architecture.

About the team
Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empowers us to celebrate our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and diversity conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We have a career path for you no matter what stage you’re in when you start here. We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering.
- Demonstrated understanding of gate-drive timing, fast protection and deterministic real-time behavior.
- Experience working closely with power-electronics, controls and embedded-software engineers.
- Experience documenting design decisions, assumptions, trade-offs, risks and technical specifications.
- Experience using engineering analysis and measured evidence to drive decisions.

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering.
- 5+ years experience in FPGA/RTL for real-time power-electronics or grid/motor control, including protection-grade timing and verification.
- Demonstrated strong FPGA design experience using VHDL and/or Verilog.
- Demonstrated working effectively with adjacent engineering disciplines and contributing to full A-to-Z product ownership.
- Demonstrated operating effectively in a greenfield environment where standards and reference designs may require interpretation and adaptation.

title: Forensic Security Engineer III, ITI Forensics
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Security is hiring a senior Security Engineer to take on our hardest digital forensic investigations and build the tools that make them faster and easier. This is a senior forensics role: you set technical direction, solve cases no one else can, and raise the bar for the whole team.

You will:
- Run complex insider-threat and misconduct investigations end to end -- consult, acquire forensically sound data, and analyze it.
- Guide other engineers through their hardest cases and sharpen how the team works.
- Partner with customers across Amazon Security and Legal, build trust, and turn that trust into new work.
- Design and ship forensic tooling in Python and AWS CDK that unlocks new data sources and scales to meet the demands of Amazon's ecosystem.

We invent new ways to do forensic acquisition and processing in a remote, cloud-first world -- all on AWS.

Key job responsibilities
- Lead the toughest digital forensic investigations end to end: customer consultation, forensically sound acquisition, and analysis across laptops, mobile devices, AWS cloud resources, and large log sets.
- Drive technical direction for how the team runs investigations, and raise the bar on quality, soundness, and speed.
- Mentor and unblock other engineers on their investigations
- Build strong customer relationships across Amazon Security and Legal, scope the right data to answer the right question, and grow new casework from that trust.
- Own forensic engineering projects from idea to production -- improving, scaling, or unlocking new acquisition and processing methods, mostly in Python and AWS CDK.
- Use code and AI to deliver results to customers faster, and improve security where it applies.
- Share on-call duty for our fault-tolerant systems and active security threats, rotating one week at a time, and fix root causes so the same page never happens twice.

A day in the life
Most days you are deep in a case. You might scope a new investigation with a customer in the morning, acquire forensically sound data from a laptop or AWS account, then analyze it and build the report that answers their question. No two cases are the same, so you design the collection and the reporting to fit.

Between cases you build. You write Python and AWS CDK tooling that collects new data sources, processes evidence at scale, and automates quality checks on results.

Your customers are internal: Amazon Security and Legal teams running insider-threat, misconduct, and e-Discovery investigations.

About the team
We are ITI Forensics, based in the DMV and Seattle. We do forensic data acquisition and analysis for customers across Amazon, and support e-Discovery for Legal.

We work collaboratively, both on cases and on the tools we build to collect new data sources, process evidence at scale, and automate quality checks. Most cases are unique and call for bespoke collection and reporting, so we invent new ways to do forensic acquisition and processing in a remote world.

Diverse Experiences
Amazon Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why Amazon Security?
At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.

Inclusive Team Culture
In Amazon Security, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices.

Training & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Basic qualifications

- 4+ years of non-internship background in troubleshooting systems issues, analyzing logs, or automating complex tasks using command line tools experience
- 4+ years of work in identifying security issues and risks, and developing mitigation plans experience
- 2+ years of (non-internship) scripting, programming, and security code review in common programming languages experience
- Knowledge of at least two of the following programming languages: Scala, Java, Python, C/C++, or Go

If you like to use IT principles like computer architecture and the OSI model (Open Systems Interconnection Model) and apply them to finding solutions to problems, we’d like to meet you. Your work will help to maintain one of the world's largest information system infrastructures.

This position requires that the candidate selected be a US Citizen and must currently possess and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance with polygraph.

Key job responsibilities
You will be required to engage in physical data center activities with or without reasonable accommodation. This includes all tasks associated with planning and tracking capacity, rack deployment, rack cabling, hardware and software troubleshooting, and rack decommissioning.

These activities include the following:

title: Area Manager, Early Career (2027)
descriptionHtml:
Power that runs the world | Discover careers in Operations

Operations roles at Amazon put you at the center of how things move from a click to a doorstep. You'll help design, improve, and run systems that connect people, products, and places, at scale. You'll take ownership early, work closely with teams to solve real-world challenges, and see the direct results of your decisions as they reach customers every day. Here, the impact of what you build isn't abstract, it's visible, immediate, and meaningful - keeping one of the world's most complex operations moving forward. This is where your journey takes shape through action, responsibility, and the opportunity to grow in many directions.

This is not a corporate, remote or office-based position. This is a full-time, early career position located within one of Amazon’s fulfillment centers, sort centers, delivery stations or other operations buildings. Amazon is seeking customer focused individuals to lead a team of hourly employees across our Operations network! Our warehouses are fast-paced environments where standing, walking, and having on-the-production floor conversations are common as a supply chain leader.

As an Area Manager, you will be responsible for engaging, leading and developing your team in a warehouse environment. Your main focus will be motivating, mentoring, and managing your team to meet goals. Amazon provides extensive training and development to become an exceptional people leader. As a people manager, you will ensure that your team has all the tools needed to succeed and maintain the highest levels of safety, quality, attendance and performance at work.

Visit this page to find more information on each of our building types. https://www.aboutamazon.com/workplace/facilities

Please note we are not able to provide sponsorship now or in the future for these positions. Eligible candidates must have work authorization without employer intervention to be considered.

This posting encompasses all openings in the country. Site placement is matched by aligning your location preferences with location availability after your interview. Relocation benefits are offered at time of offer to eligible candidates.

Benefits: Medical, financial, and/or other benefits. Visit this page to learn more about the benefits Amazon offers. https://www.amazon.jobs/content/en/benefits



Key job responsibilities
• Support, mentor and motivate 50-100 direct report Amazon Associates.
• Work independently and operate in an autonomous environment.
• Stand/walk during shifts lasting up to 12 hours.
• Willing and able to regularly work shift patterns that include nights, weekends, and/or holidays based on business needs. While shifts vary site to site, most follow a fixed 4-day work week with 3 days off.
• Oversee truck deliveries, handle and sort packages using pallet jacks, operate PIT. equipment (at applicable facilities) and step in as needed.
• Work in an environment where the noise level varies.
• Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend and reach.
• Climb and descend stairs (when applicable).


A day in the life
As an Area Manager, no two days look exactly the same, but every shift gives you the chance to lead a team, solve real problems, and directly impact how millions of customers receive their orders.
Start of Shift: Set the Tone
• Get a handoff from the outgoing manager and review what's carrying over so nothing falls through the cracks.
• Lead a team huddle to kick off the shift. Huddles are used to align on goals, safety priorities, and key focus areas.
• Confirm your team is in place, positioned for success, and ready to go before operations begin.
Middle of Shift: Lead from the Floor
• Walk the floor regularly to stay connected to your team, spot issues early, and keep things running smoothly.
• Drive results across safety, quality, and productivity — balancing all three in real time.
• Adjust staffing and resources as volume and priorities shift throughout the day.
• Coach and develop your team members, respond to challenges as they come up, and partner with support teams to remove roadblocks.
• Keep peers and leadership informed on how the shift is tracking and flag risks before they become problems.
End of Shift: Close Strong
• Do a final walkthrough to make sure your area is clean, organized, and set up for the next team's success.
• Review your shift's performance data and capture what went well and what to improve
• Hand off to the incoming manager with a clear picture of priorities, open items, and next steps.
• Wrap up any remaining administrative tasks so you leave the shift with a clean slate.
• Every shift, you'll see the direct results of your leadership: from the energy of your team to the packages that reach customers' doorsteps. This is where your decisions have real, visible impact.

Basic qualifications

- 1+ years of employee and performance management experience
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or 2+ years of Amazon (blue badge/FTE) experience
- Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
- Can push and pull wheeled dollies loaded with products up to 100 pounds during shifts

title: Software Development Engineer - ML, Prime Video Personalization, Harmonia Optimizer
descriptionHtml:
Prime Video is building the future of TV for customers in over 200 countries to enjoy an endless selection of movies, shows and sports on their TV, mobile devices and desktop. We deliver high-quality video to Amazon customers through subscriptions (Amazon Prime, and Channels) as well as purchases, rentals, and free with ads.

In Prime Video Personalization and Discovery, our mission is to show a customer the right video content, in the right place, at the right time. We tailor PV for a diverse and global audience, so customers world-wide with different tastes and backgrounds can find something to watch and enjoy on every visit. We delight Prime subscribers by leaning in to the Amazon originals and exclusives that shape our brand and differentiate us. We grow our relationships with customers by leveraging our deep understanding of them to provide relevant and timely recommendations. We believe the current customer experience is only scratching the surface of innovative experiences that are made possible as viewing continues to shift online, and that science is at the center of delivering a step-function change for our CX.

Key job responsibilities
Creating reliable, scalable, and high performance products requires exceptional technical expertise, a sound understanding of the fundamentals of Computer Science, and practical experience building large-scale distributed systems. This person has thrived and succeeded in delivering high quality technology products/services in a hyper-growth environment where priorities shift fast.

A day in the life
We are looking for a Software Development Engineer who is results-oriented, data driven, innovative and passionate at creating new comprehensive customer engagement services/solutions. You’ll work on technologies such as such as Large Language Models (LLMs), Java, Python and AWS to build the world’s most innovative customer experience solutions. You will have significant influence on our overall product strategy and overall architecture of the video-on-demand catalog systems that source and generate title information using ML and digital video understanding, including Prime Video's first catalog experimentation platform. In partnership with your team, you will be responsible for changing the way our customers discover and choose movies in Prime Video.

About the team
Our team are Software Engineers working together with Applied Scientists and Product Managers in an experiment driven, agile development process. You'll get to collaborate with teammates on distributed software solutions and get the chance to learn about the machine learning domain.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- 1+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience
- 1+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience
- 1+ years of Object Oriented Design experience
- Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

title: Mechatronic Apprentice I
descriptionHtml:
Operations is at the heart of Amazon’s business. We are known for our speed, accuracy, and exceptional service. Our buildings deliver tens of thousands of products to hundreds of countries worldwide, every day. Reliability Maintenance & Engineering (RME) are the business partners that work tirelessly behind the scenes to make it all happen. We drive continuous improvement, and maintain all of the Robotics and Material Handling Equipment (MHE) to ensure our customers are met with the Amazon smile. Come join us on our journey!
About the Role:

As a Mechatronics & Robotics Apprentice (MRA), you will learn to combine electronic, mechanical, computer and automation engineering skills at the workplace. During on-the-job learning (OJL) you will work with complex high-performance manufacturing systems and will learn to analyze, troubleshoot, and repair systems to maintain process efficiency. The focus of your role will be to learn the skills and abilities to ensure safety regulations and policies are adhered to, assist in the installation, maintenance, and repair of the automated packaging and distribution equipment, ensure preventative maintenance is conducted on time to a high standard, and provide high levels of equipment availability through continuous improvement.

You will be paired with journey workers to carry out their work at various facilities, including high automation and robotics facilities in connection with service operations. You will be expected to complete work based on technical documents and instructions and carry out your work in compliance with the relevant provisions and safety regulations.

You should be an effective communicator, work well in a team, and be self-motivated. You must have the ability to work collaboratively and coordinate your activities with upstream and downstream operations partners. In addition to developing your skills, you will be mentored by senior technicians to grow in your role.


Key job responsibilities
- You will perform preventive and predictive maintenance on conveyance equipment and robotic work cells following established job plans.

- You will conduct basic troubleshooting and corrective maintenance on robotics systems.

- You will troubleshoot electrical and mechanical problems across material handling equipment components, using schematics, technical documentation, and hands-on diagnostic techniques to isolate and resolve root causes.

- You will maintain, inspect, and replace electromechanical components, such as motors, photo eyes, relays, proximity sensors, solenoids, motor starters, tachs, etc. under the guidance of senior technicians.

- You will support the maintenance team with inspections, work order documentation, and any other assigned tasks as directed by site leadership.

Physical requirements:
You must be able to move up to 49lbs, stand and walk during shifts lasting up to 12 hours, climb ladders and gangways safely, and without limitation, as well as perform regular bending, lifting, stretching, and reaching both below the waist and above the head

Program Requirements:
• Flexible to relocate after completion of the program

• Able to enroll in and attend a 9-week training at one of four designated training providers

• Meet the minimum qualifying score on a Mechanical Aptitude Test

Please note that while we strive to accommodate employees' preferences for shift assignments, due to operational requirements and scheduling constraints, we cannot guarantee a specific shift assignment.

Basic qualifications

- High School Diploma
- 1+ years of PC software experience including Microsoft Word, Excel and Outlook experience
- Experience troubleshooting and repairing operational items
- Knowledge of mathematics
- Experience measurement reading and interpretation
- vocational/technical training or an associate degree or above, or 1+ years of Amazon RME (Reliability Maintenance Engineering) experience, or 2+ years of military service (E-2+) experience

Preferred qualifications

- 4+ years of military experience
- Experience conducting predictive and preventative maintenance procedures
- Experience troubleshooting and diagnosing material handling equipment (MHE)
- Experience implementing safety standards
- Experience reading blueprints and electrical schematics

title: Drone Avionics Electrical Engineer, Prime Air
descriptionHtml:
As an Electrical Hardware Engineer on our team, you will be responsible for end-to-end hardware development lifecycle across design, validation, and manufacturing for flight-critical avionics systems. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams - including propulsion, structures, firmware, software, safety, certification, production - to meet the highest standards of safety and reliability.


Key job responsibilities
Own the product development lifecycle of hardware within the avionics system
Develop and execute verification and validation test plans, including qualification and compliance against aerospace standards (e.g., DO-160, DO-254)
Bring up EE hardware, validate interfaces, and unblock system integration across the flight computer and connected sensor subsystems
Lead root cause analysis of hardware failures across hardware/software interfaces, then develop corrective actions and implement fixes in production hardware
Drive DFM and DFR with fabrication, assembly, and qualification vendors, and lead manufacturing, in-service, and reliability initiatives for avionics hardware in production

About the team
Prime Air is Amazon's autonomous drone delivery service. Our mission is to build a safe, ultra-fast, and convenient drone delivery system that transforms the way packages are delivered to customers worldwide. Avionics Hardware Team at Prime Air develops and sustains Electrical and Electronics (EE) Hardware for the avionics systems of autonomous drones - including flight computers, air data sensors, cameras, radars, lighting systems, and electrical wiring interconnect systems - at Amazon's delivery scale.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, or experience with modern ASIC/FPGA design and verification tools
- Experience with prototyping and implementation
- Experience in root cause analysis and error correction, identifying changes to procedures and systems to implement long-term fixes and avoid repeating issues
- Experience in motherboard design, PCB design including schematic capture, stackup and circuit board layout

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree in electrical engineering or equivalent
- 5+ years of hardware development, test lab, space/aerospace maintenance or hands-on engineering environment experience
- Experience with product level validation testing (Thermal, EMC/EMI, Shock, Cycle Testing, etc.)
- Experience in reliability engineering, including accelerated life testing, failure rate modeling, and Design Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (DFMEA).
